body.en: This change is a low-level connection cleanup for developers and users who want to know how the VS Code extension communicates with the editor. Several long-unused legacy tools (including opening files, saving documents, getting the list of open editors, and related features) have been officially removed from the connection between Claude Code and the IDE. ⟦Clearing out a utility truck's trunk by unloading spare parts that sat untouched for years leaves the toolbox much leaner.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Removed unused tools from the IDE connection (openFile, saveDocument, getOpenEditors and related)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 編輯差異檢視不受中斷也不秀舊提案
title.en: VS Code diff views stay open without interruption or stale proposals

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 同時開著側邊欄聊天和內建終端機寫程式，審核 Claude 的改檔差異最怕畫面被搶走或顯示舊版。現在同一視窗裡的終端機工作階段送出提示詞時，聊天視窗正在看的修改差異會維持開啟並繼續等你確認，不會被中斷關閉。

另外在終端機工作階段的差異畫面手動輸入內容後，如果 Claude 再次編輯同一份檔案，畫面現在會顯示最新的修改內容，不再錯秀成上一輪的舊提案。⟦就像同時開著兩條生產線核對設計圖，別桌同事喊了一聲，你手上的比對螢幕依然亮著等你簽字，新改的圖紙也會即時換上去。⟧
body.en:
When coding in VS Code with both the sidebar chat and the integrated terminal open, the last thing you want while reviewing Claude's file diffs is losing focus or seeing an outdated version. Now, when a terminal session in the same window sends a prompt, any chat edit diff you are viewing stays open and continues waiting for your approval instead of closing abruptly.

Additionally, after you type manually in a terminal session's diff view, if Claude edits the same file again, the screen now displays the latest changes rather than mistakenly showing the previous round's proposal. ⟦Two production lines run side by side for blueprint checks, and when a colleague at another desk calls out, your comparison monitor stays lit waiting for your sign-off while newly revised drawings swap in right away.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a terminal session's diff showing the previous proposed edit after you typed in it and Claude edited the same file again
[VSCode] Changed a chat edit's diff to stay open and keep asking for approval when a terminal session in the same window sends a prompt

title.zh-TW: VS Code 權限視窗與彈出選單顯示及按鍵修復
title.en: VS Code fixes for permission prompts, popups, and Escape key

body.zh-TW:
VS Code 彈出權限確認框或你想按 `Esc` 關掉小選單，過去常遇到關鍵訊息被裁掉，或是一按就把 Claude 回到一半的對話整段喊停。

當 `PreToolUse` hook 要求確認時，權限視窗現在會正常顯示它提供的理由；太長的工具名稱或檔案名稱在視窗標題上也不再被截斷。

按 `Esc` 關閉回饋視窗、`"Build a custom style"` 對話框、`@` 標記選單，或是模型、模式、`+` 等彈出選單時，不再順便把正在進行的 Claude 回覆一併中止。
body.en:
When a VS Code permission prompt popped up or you pressed `Esc` to close a small menu, key details used to get cut off, or a single keypress would halt Claude's mid-flight response.

When a `PreToolUse` hook asks for confirmation, the permission prompt now properly displays the reason it provides, and overly long tool or file names are no longer truncated in the prompt title.

Pressing `Esc` to close the feedback dialog, the `"Build a custom style"` dialog, the `@`-mention menu, or popups such as the model, mode, and `+` menus no longer stops Claude's ongoing response at the same time.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt not showing the reason that a PreToolUse hook gives when it asks for confirmation (anthropics/claude-code#85950)
[VSCode] Fixed long tool and file names being cut off in a permission prompt's title
[VSCode] Fixed Escape also stopping Claude's response when it closes the feedback or "Build a custom style" dialog, the @-mention menu, the model, mode or "+" menu, or another popup

title.zh-TW: VS Code 連續改檔與搜尋及啟動速度提升
title.en: VS Code speeds up consecutive edits, search, and startup

body.zh-TW:
在大型專案工作區用 VS Code 擴充功能，或是剛打開新資料夾準備開工，這版把幾項等待感明顯的步驟都調快了。

Claude 連續進行多次編輯時，排隊中的編輯會共用一次等待新診斷問題的時間，而某些問題可能會延後到較後面那次編輯才一起回報。

當系統 `PATH` 內有 `rg` 時，大型工作區裡的 `@` 檔案搜尋速度加快，排序方式變得更像終端機版，但對打錯字的容錯度會降低一些。

除了第三方服務提供者之外，首次開啟的資料夾、空白視窗與 worktree 現在一打開就能立刻點選模型選單。
body.en:
When using the VS Code extension in large workspaces or opening a new folder to get started, this release speeds up several steps where waiting used to be noticeable.

When Claude makes several edits in a row, queued edits share a single wait for new diagnostic problems, and some issues may be reported together with a later edit.

When `rg` is available on your system `PATH`, `@` file search in large workspaces is faster and ranks results more like the terminal version, though with slightly less tolerance for typos.

Except on third-party providers, folders opened for the first time, empty windows, and worktrees now let you open and select from the model picker right away.

items.original:

[VSCode] Improved @-mention file search speed in large workspaces when `rg` is on your `PATH`; results now rank much as in the terminal, with less tolerance for typos
[VSCode] Improved startup: the model picker is ready at once in folders opened for the first time, empty windows and worktrees, except on third-party providers

Changed a managed `autoMode.environment` list without `"$defaults"` to replace every built-in entry in Claude Desktop and Agent SDK apps too; add `"$defaults"` or copy the sensitive-target ones
Changed `--add-dir` and `/add-dir` in local terminal sessions to show the trust prompt for a folder you have not trusted yet; `claude --bg` refuses such a folder
Changed self-hosted runners under `--trust-workspace false` to ignore more repository settings; set such values in user or managed settings
Changed how permission answers over Remote Control and on self-hosted runners save "always allow" choices
Changed enabled plugins that were refused for a malformed `plugin.json` display field: they now load, with their hooks and MCP servers; administrators should check the plugins they deploy
Changed how `allowedHttpHookUrls` and `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` apply to hooks from managed settings
Changed HTTP hooks to ignore `Content-Length` and `Transfer-Encoding` in their `headers` setting; the request's length comes from its body
Changed plugin uninstall to also delete the files extracted from the plugin's MCP bundles (`.mcpb`, `.dxt`), unless another plugin uses the same bundle
Changed some worktree sessions to skip some plugin settings; a notice names what was skipped
Changed `/plugin` uninstall, remove and switch questions to lists answered with the arrow keys and Enter, or Esc to cancel; `y`, `n` and `u` no longer answer them
Changed automatic compaction in plan mode to use the model answering you, such as Opus with `opusplan`, so it can cost more
Changed Cowork cloud sessions to hold an organization's OpenTelemetry export until the first turn; a session that gets no message now sends nothing, so `claude_code.session.count` can fall
Changed Claude's messages to a session on another machine to be refused when your session uses an API key, auth token, profile or workload identity beside a saved claude.ai login
Changed `--bare` sessions on an unapproved API key: moving one to the background is now refused in most setups, and `claude --bare --bg` exits with an error if the background service lacks the key
Changed "Continue automatically at usage limit" to stop with a notice, sending nothing, when your login changes or ends during the wait
Remote Control: Changed how it connects through a proxy: requests now use a CONNECT tunnel, so a proxy that refuses CONNECT stops Remote Control with an error
Remote Control: Changed the session debug logs written under `--verbose` to go to `~/.claude/child-logs/`

Self-hosted runner: Changed Linux and macOS sessions with no `gh` to get a built-in `gh api` by default, via Anthropic, which adds their GitHub sign-in, if any; `--use-anthropic-gh false` turns it off
Changed agent view so that quitting with Ctrl+C twice, Ctrl+D twice or `/exit` after pressing `←` in an empty conversation ends that session, instead of leaving it running for 5 minutes
Changed `--await-initialize` to be refused with `--bg` or `--worktree --tmux`, which never read the initialize request, instead of starting without the fields it carries
Changed worktree creation, `/teleport` and IDE checkouts to run git with a stricter `PATH`; a git filter or helper may need its full path
Changed the card for approving a subagent's plan to two choices, "Yes, and switch to default (ask each time) for this session" and "No", chosen with the arrow keys and Enter (typed text moves to No)
Changed the `/claude-api` skill to build agents on Managed Agents by default, unless you want to host the agent loop yourself
Changed `/usage` in fullscreen mode to show plan limit bars before session cost for subscribers; `/cost` still starts with cost
Changed the wording of some messages that `claude` subcommands print; JSON output is unchanged
Changed first-run setup to preselect the "Auto (match terminal)" theme instead of Dark mode
Changed fullscreen `/cd` to refuse "Yes" while its trust prompt doesn't fit, with a line saying to make the window taller
Removed the tmux notice that said the mouse wheel needs `set -g mouse on` in fullscreen; the wheel scrolls without it
Removed the spinner tip that suggested `/clear` 30 minutes into a running turn
[VSCode] Added a `claudeCode.promptSuggestions` setting that turns prompt suggestions off
[VSCode] Fixed "Rewind code to here" in a forked conversation sometimes undoing one turn too many and deleting files created in that turn
[VSCode] Fixed the Sandbox dialog creating empty files and folders in the home directory and the project's `.git` folder while the sandbox is off
[VSCode] Fixed the saved sign-in being lost on some networks
[VSCode] Fixed sign-in ending when a verification code, a web address or a code from another sign-in attempt is pasted; the panel now says what to paste instead
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen showing briefly each time a panel or window opened while signed in to Console without an API key
[VSCode] Fixed the usage-limit banner's "Request more" button for Team and Enterprise members coming back after each press without sending anything, after you signed in again during a session

[VSCode] Fixed `/ide` in a second Claude Code session silently losing the editor connection back to the first session; the newest connection now wins and the displaced session shows how to switch back
[VSCode] Fixed saved memories not being listed in the Memory dialog, or RAM use growing without end, when the memory folder held symlink loops, and a hang when it held a named pipe
[VSCode] Fixed a running command's live output stopping after one failed read
[VSCode] Fixed "Open in Terminal" showing only the shell's error when `claude` could not be started: in bash, zsh, fish and Git Bash, a notice now explains why and links to the install guide
[VSCode] Fixed the panel showing no "Open artifact" link after Claude publishes an artifact
[VSCode] Fixed the prompt suggestion hiding the "attach selected text" hint while the chat panel is unfocused
[VSCode] Fixed buttons with no visible border in the high-contrast themes, and the dark welcome art on the sign-in screen in Light High Contrast
[VSCode] Improved Edit and Write speed: no wait for new problems on files that are not open in a tab when the editor has been reporting none for such files
[VSCode] Changed a running command's live output in the chat to look like the command card's OUT row
[VSCode] Changed the text of extension errors in event listeners, views and activation to stay out of the editor's own error telemetry

title.zh-TW: agent teams 可用 Code Mode
title.en: Agent teams can now use Code Mode

body.zh-TW: 開了多代理協作的 agent teams 後，現在也能同時打開 Code Mode 了。如果你原本就已經開啟 Code Mode，之後只要啟動帶有 agent teams 的工作階段，就會直接從 Code Mode 起步，不必再手動切換。⟦就像登山隊出門前先調好對講機頻道，以前兩項裝備不能同時開，現在出門時開關一拉就直接進到同一個頻道。⟧
body.en: With multi-agent collaboration in agent teams enabled, you can now turn on Code Mode at the same time. If you already had Code Mode turned on, any session you start with agent teams will now launch directly in Code Mode without needing to switch manually. ⟦Picture a mountaineering team tuning their radio channels before heading out: previously, two pieces of gear could not be switched on together, but now flipping the switch on the way out puts everyone straight onto the same channel.⟧

items.original: Added support for turning on Code Mode while agent teams are enabled; if you already turned it on, sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 權限檢查與提示更新
title.en: Code Mode permission checks and prompt updates

body.zh-TW:
在 auto mode 下使用 Code Mode，若技能或斜線指令內嵌 `!` 指令需要核准，現在會改請 Claude 執行，不再直接載入失敗。

背景子代理預先載入這類技能時也不再出錯。沙盒指令的權限檢查同步收緊，更多指令會先詢問或直接拒絕。

無法開啟 Code Mode 時，畫面會說明可採取的做法。`$` Shell 輔助工具也會直接擋下部分輸入並報錯，不會執行任何動作。
body.en:
When using Code Mode in auto mode, if a skill or slash command has an inline `!` command that needs approval, Claude is now asked to run it instead of failing to load.

Background subagents also no longer fail when preloading these skills. Permission checks for sandboxed commands have been tightened as well, so more commands now ask first or are refused outright.

When Code Mode cannot be turned on, the message now explains what you can do. The `$` shell helper also refuses certain inputs with an error without running anything.

items.original:
Fixed skills and slash commands failing to load in Code Mode under auto mode when an inline `!` command needs approval; Claude is now asked to run it
Fixed background subagents started in Code Mode failing when they preload a skill with an inline `!` command
Improved permission checks in Code Mode; more sandboxed commands now ask or are refused
Improved the messages shown when Code Mode can't be turned on, so they say what you can do
Changed Code Mode's `$` shell helper to refuse some values with an error; nothing runs

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 擴充模組排版與資料夾把關
title.en: Code Mode mod layout and folder safeguards

body.zh-TW:
給開發 Code Mode mod（擴充模組）的人：區塊元件新增水平捲動支援，文字元件加入最大行數與裁切選項，文字換行截斷時也不再漏行。

模組現在也能正常透過 Code Mode 介面呼叫 Bash 與 Read 等工具。

一般使用者在工作階段的 mods 資料夾改檔案時，現在會更常跳出詢問。沙盒指令可寫入的資料夾也變少了。若每次編輯都一直被問，只要刪掉裡面連往無法讀取或網路路徑的連結就好。
body.en:
For those building Code Mode mods (custom extensions): the box component now supports horizontal scrolling, the text component adds max-lines and clipping options, and wrapped text no longer drops lines when truncated.

Mods can now also call tools like Bash and Read through the Code Mode interface as expected.

For general users, editing files in a session's mods folder now triggers prompts more often. Sandboxed commands can also write to fewer folders. If you are prompted on every edit, simply remove any links inside pointing to unreadable or network paths.

items.original:
Added `overflowX="scroll"` on a mod's `Box`, and `maxLines` and `wrap="clip"` on its `Text`
Fixed mods being unable to use Bash, Read and other tools through `$.tool.call` and `$.tool.check` in Code Mode
Fixed a mod's `Text` with `wrap="truncate-end"` losing rows on the terminal when it holds a line feed
Changed edits in a session's mods folder to ask more often, and sandboxed commands to write to fewer folders; if every edit asks, remove any link there to an unreadable or network path

title.zh-TW: 未指定模式時改為預設進 auto mode
title.en: Default to auto mode when no mode is set

body.zh-TW:
套用 Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA 設定的組織，終端機與 VS Code 工作階段現在預設進入 auto mode。想關閉這個預設行為，只要加上 `disableAutoMode` 即可。

若尚未設定模式且組織政策還沒載入，工作階段也會先採 auto mode，不再退回手動模式。

等設定載入完成後，預設採 auto mode 的工作階段會改套用伺服器管理的預設模式；若設定與政策都載入失敗，或政策要求改回，才會退成手動模式。⟦飯店還沒收到旅客的特殊房型備忘前，櫃檯先按標準房流程安排入住；等備忘單送到或連線失敗時，再照規定改回人工確認。⟧
body.en:
For organizations using the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration, terminal and VS Code sessions now start in auto mode by default. To turn off this default behavior, simply add `disableAutoMode`.

If no mode is set and the organization's policy has not loaded yet, sessions also start in auto mode instead of falling back to Manual mode.

Once settings finish loading, sessions that start in auto mode by default switch to the server-managed default mode; they only fall back to Manual mode if both settings and policy fail to load, or if the policy requires it. ⟦Before a hotel receives a guest's special room-type memo, the front desk checks them in using the standard room process; once the memo arrives or the connection fails, they switch back to manual confirmation as required.⟧

items.original:
Changed terminal and VS Code sessions in organizations with the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration to start in auto mode by default; `disableAutoMode` turns it off
Changed terminal and VS Code sessions with no mode set to start in auto mode, not Manual mode, when your organization's policy hasn't loaded
Changed sessions that start in auto by default to take a server-managed `defaultMode` once settings load, or Manual if settings fail with no stored copy and policy fails or requires it

title.zh-TW: Auto mode 分類器與用量計費修正
title.en: Auto mode classifier and usage billing fixes

body.zh-TW:
套用 Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA 設定的組織，只要是直連 Anthropic API，現在會跟其他組織一樣改由伺服器端分類器檢查動作。

先前因為舊版殘留設定，auto mode 有時會卡在計入使用量的本機分類器，這個問題也已經修好，不會再白白消耗你的用量。⟦好比把原本記在個人帳本上的審核手續，交回總部統一查驗，舊版留下的誤記規則也一併清掉。⟧
body.en:
For organizations using the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration on a direct Anthropic API connection, actions are now checked by the server-side classifier, just like other organizations.

An issue where stale settings from an older version could leave auto mode stuck on the local classifier—which counts toward usage—has also been fixed, so it no longer wastes your usage. ⟦It is like handing review procedures previously logged in a personal ledger back to headquarters for unified inspection, while clearing out misrecorded rules left over from an earlier version.⟧

items.original:
Fixed auto mode staying on its local classifier, which counts toward usage, because of a stale saved value, such as one from an older Claude Code
Changed auto mode for organizations with the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration: on a direct Anthropic API connection, the server-side classifier now checks actions, as for other organizations

title.zh-TW: Auto mode 收緊萬用字元放行規則
title.en: Auto mode tightens wildcard allow rules

body.zh-TW:
過去在 auto mode 能直接跑過的一些 Shell 指令，現在會被擋下。

沒寫明程式名稱或以 `$HOME` 開頭的萬用字元放行規則，auto mode 現在會略過不採信，改由安全檢查決定是否放行。

程式路徑使用 Windows 反斜線的萬用字元規則，現在也會經過安全判斷而可能被攔截，只有精確比對的規則仍會直接放行。以 `.\` 開頭的規則，官方後續計畫恢復放行。⟦海關人員不再看到沒填品名的空白申報單就免驗放行，只有把確切品名寫清楚的包裹才能直接過關。⟧
body.en:
Some shell commands that previously ran directly in auto mode are now blocked.

Wildcard allow rules that do not name a program or that start with `$HOME` are now ignored by auto mode, leaving the safety check to decide whether to allow them.

Wildcard rules whose program path uses Windows backslashes are now also evaluated by the safety check and may be blocked, while exact-match rules still allow calls directly. Rules starting with `.\` are planned to be restored later. ⟦Customs officers no longer wave through blank declaration forms with no item name filled in; only packages with the exact item name clearly written can pass straight through.⟧

items.original:
Changed auto mode to stop some shell commands that ran before
Changed auto mode to ignore some wildcard shell allow rules, such as ones that name no program or that start with `$HOME`, so the safety check decides those commands
Changed auto mode to judge wildcard allow rules whose program is a Windows backslash path, so those calls can be blocked; exact rules keep their allow; we plan to restore rules that start with `.\`

title.zh-TW: 組織管理設定在桌面版與 SDK 的套用調整
title.en: Managed settings updates for Claude Desktop and SDK

body.zh-TW:
給採用組織管理設定的團隊與開發者：在 Claude Desktop 的 Code 分頁，管理設定指定的子代理模型現在會蓋過個人設定，跟終端機版相同。不過若管理設定本身也指定了供應商或閘道，就不會覆蓋。

若管理設定裡 `autoMode` 的 `environment` 清單沒寫 `"$defaults"`，現在在 Claude Desktop 與 Agent SDK 應用程式也會取代所有內建項目。想保留預設保護，記得加上 `"$defaults"` 或自行複製敏感目標項目。⟦總公司訂好的團隊守則，以前進到桌面分部還會照員工自己的設定或預設清單走，現在一樣直接蓋過個人做法並整套替換。⟧
body.en:
For teams and developers using managed settings: in Claude Desktop's Code tab, the subagent model specified in managed settings now overrides your personal setting, just like in the terminal. However, if those managed settings also specify a provider or gateway, it will not override.

If the `environment` list under `autoMode` in managed settings omits `"$defaults"`, it now replaces all built-in entries in Claude Desktop and Agent SDK apps as well. To keep the default protections, remember to add `"$defaults"` or copy the sensitive-target entries yourself. ⟦A head office's team rules used to still defer to an employee's own settings or default list at the desktop branch, but now they override personal practices and replace the whole set there too.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the subagent model set in managed settings not applying in Claude Desktop's Code tab; it now overrides your own, as in a terminal, unless those settings also pick a provider or gateway
Changed a managed `autoMode.environment` list without `"$defaults"` to replace every built-in entry in Claude Desktop and Agent SDK apps too; add `"$defaults"` or copy the sensitive-target ones

title.zh-TW: 設定檔寫入失敗與語法錯誤改為明確警告
title.en: Clearer warnings for settings write failures and syntax errors

body.zh-TW:
啟動時若 `--allowedTools`、`--disallowedTools` 或 `--tools` 裡有不完整的規則，現在會跳出警告。

在 `/permissions`、主對話工具提示或 `/add-dir` 新增規則與資料夾時，若設定檔無法寫入，終端機不會再裝作已存檔，而是直接點名檔案發出警告。

工作階段中途存到有錯的設定檔時，現在也會點名提示。設定檔或 `.mcp.json` 若有 JSON 語法錯誤，錯誤訊息會直接指出第幾行第幾欄。
body.en:
If `--allowedTools`, `--disallowedTools`, or `--tools` contains an incomplete rule at startup, a warning now appears.

When adding rules or folders via `/permissions`, a main-conversation tool prompt, or `/add-dir`, if the settings file cannot be written, the terminal no longer acts as if it were saved and instead issues a warning naming the file.

When a settings file is saved with an error mid-session, a warning now names the file as well. If a settings file or `.mcp.json` has a JSON syntax error, the error message now points directly to the line and column.

items.original:
Added a startup warning when an `--allowedTools`, `--disallowedTools` or `--tools` value has an entry that doesn't look like a complete rule
Fixed rules added in `/permissions` or at a main-conversation tool prompt, and `/add-dir` folders, looking saved when the settings file couldn't be written; the terminal now warns and names it
Fixed a settings file saved with an error mid-session being skipped silently; a warning now names the file
Improved the error for a settings or `.mcp.json` file with broken JSON: it now gives the line and column

title.zh-TW: 修正管理設定鍵名與過深巢狀導致當機
title.en: Fix crashes from managed setting key names and deep nesting

body.zh-TW:
組織管理設定裡只要出現特定鍵名，過去會讓 Claude Code 無法啟動，或意外影響其他管理設定檔。這個問題已經修好，管理設定現在能正常載入。

設定檔裡若出現巢狀深達數千層的數值，過去會造成當機或時靈時不靈；現在超過 64 層的值會直接捨棄並跳出警告。⟦跟拆多層禮物盒一樣，規定拆到第六十四層還沒見底就直接退件提醒，不再硬拆到整張桌子垮掉。⟧
body.en:
Previously, certain key names in managed settings could prevent Claude Code from starting or unexpectedly affect other managed settings files. This has been fixed, and managed settings now load normally.

Values nested thousands of levels deep in settings files used to cause crashes or intermittent failures; now any value past 64 levels is dropped with a warning. ⟦Like unwrapping a multi-layered gift box, the rule now rejects and flags anything that hasn't reached the bottom by layer 64, instead of prying it open until the whole table collapses.⟧

items.original:
Fixed managed settings with certain key names stopping Claude Code from starting or affecting other managed files
Fixed settings files with values nested thousands of levels deep crashing Claude Code or applying only some of the time; values past 64 levels are now dropped with a warning

title.zh-TW: 管理員的 OpenTelemetry 遙測記錄調整
title.en: OpenTelemetry telemetry updates for admins

body.zh-TW:
給管理 OpenTelemetry 遙測資料的管理員：現在多了環境變數 `OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST`（預設關閉）。開啟後，遙測資源屬性就會一併附上主機名稱與主機識別資訊。

組織管理設定裡的 `PreToolUse` hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）若直接拒絕工具呼叫，現在也會確實留下決策事件與拒絕紀錄。

Cowork 雲端工作階段現在會等到第一輪對話才送出組織的遙測資料。沒有收到任何訊息的工作階段不會送出資料，因此計數可能下降。⟦換個方式看，店裡改成真的有人進門問話才記一次來客，只推門看一眼就走的不再算進統計。⟧
body.en:
For administrators managing OpenTelemetry telemetry data: a new environment variable `OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST` (off by default) is now available. When enabled, telemetry resource attributes also include the host name and host ID.

If a `PreToolUse` hook (a small program triggered by specific events) in managed settings directly refuses a tool call, it now reliably leaves both a decision event and a denial record.

Cowork cloud sessions now wait until the first turn of conversation before sending an organization's telemetry data. Sessions that receive no messages send nothing, so counts may decrease. ⟦Put another way, a shop now logs a visitor only when someone actually steps in to ask a question, instead of counting people who just push the door open for a quick look and leave.⟧

items.original:
Added `OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST` to include `host.name` and `host.id` in OpenTelemetry resource attributes (off by default)
Fixed PreToolUse hooks in managed settings leaving no OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` event or `permission_denials` entry when they refused a direct tool call
Changed Cowork cloud sessions to hold an organization's OpenTelemetry export until the first turn; a session that gets no message now sends nothing, so `claude_code.session.count` can fall

title.zh-TW: Hook 執行失敗與擋下動作時顯示原因
title.en: Show reasons when hooks fail or block actions

body.zh-TW:
Node 或 Python 寫的 hook 若當掉，過去只會印出錯誤追蹤的第一行；現在會直接顯示錯誤，按下 `Ctrl+O` 還能看到最多 10,000 字元的輸出。

`PreToolUse` hook 若回傳結束碼 127，錯誤訊息也會直接提醒檢查可能根本沒跑起來。

對話紀錄裡的狀態顏色也更好辨認：失敗或逾時的 hook 改成紅色顯示，擋下 Claude 執行的改成黃色，並把原因直接列在下方。
body.en:
When a Node or Python hook crashes, it previously printed only the first line of its stack trace; now the error is shown directly, and pressing `Ctrl+O` reveals up to 10,000 characters of output.

If a `PreToolUse` hook returns exit code 127, the error message now reminds you that its check may not have run at all.

Status colors in the transcript are also easier to tell apart: failed or timed-out hooks now appear in red, hooks that stop Claude appear in yellow, and the reason is listed right underneath.

items.original:
Fixed a crashed Node or Python hook showing only the first line of its stack trace; the error is now shown, and Ctrl+O shows up to 10,000 characters of the output
Improved the error when a PreToolUse hook exits 127, saying its check may not have run
Improved hook failures, blocks and timeouts in the transcript: failures are now red instead of grey, a hook that stops Claude is yellow, and the reason is shown under them

title.zh-TW: Hook 改寫輸入、阻擋範圍與 HTTP 規則變更
title.en: Changes to hook input rewrites, blocking scope, and HTTP rules

body.zh-TW:
多個 `PreToolUse` hook 同時回應同一次工具呼叫，改寫後的輸入參數現在在更多情況下都能保留生效。

Hook 回傳的阻擋決定現在適用更多情況；如果某支 hook 原本每次都固定印出 `"decision": "block"`，更新後可能會開始真的擋下呼叫。

來自管理設定的 hook，也調整了 `allowedHttpHookUrls` 與 `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` 的套用規則。HTTP hook 現在會忽略標頭設定裡的 `Content-Length` 與 `Transfer-Encoding`，改依請求內容計算長度。
body.en:
When multiple `PreToolUse` hooks respond to the same tool call, rewritten input parameters now stay in effect in more cases.

A hook's blocking decision now applies in more cases; if a hook previously always printed `"decision": "block"`, it may start actually blocking calls after this update.

Hooks from managed settings also have updated rules for how `allowedHttpHookUrls` and `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` apply. HTTP hooks now ignore `Content-Length` and `Transfer-Encoding` in their header settings, calculating the length from the request body instead.

items.original:
Improved how a PreToolUse hook's `updatedInput` is kept when more than one hook answers a tool call; the rewrite now runs in more cases
Changed a hook's `"decision": "block"` to hold in more cases, so a hook that always prints one may start blocking calls
Changed how `allowedHttpHookUrls` and `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` apply to hooks from managed settings
Changed HTTP hooks to ignore `Content-Length` and `Transfer-Encoding` in their `headers` setting; the request's length comes from its body

title.zh-TW: Monitor 逾時無事件時會指出錯誤紀錄檔
title.en: Monitor points to error log file when timing out with no events

body.zh-TW: 用 Monitor 監看背景程序卻等到逾時都沒事件，若背後的指令其實把錯誤印到了標準錯誤輸出，現在會主動告訴 Claude 這件事，並附上存放輸出的檔案路徑。
body.en: When using Monitor to watch a background process and it times out with no events, if the underlying command wrote errors to stderr, Claude is now proactively informed and given the path to the file holding the output.

items.original: Improved Monitor: when a watch expires with no events and its command wrote to stderr, Claude is now told so and told which file holds the output

title.zh-TW: 中途加入 managed-mcp.json 的套用與說明
title.en: Applying and explaining managed-mcp.json added mid-session

body.zh-TW:
管理員在工作階段進行途中新增 `managed-mcp.json`，MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器會停止載入。現在畫面上會出現說明訊息，告訴你為什麼伺服器停了下來。

這種中途加入的設定現在有機會在下一次檢查時就開始生效；不過要讓設定完整套用，還是得重開目前開啟中的工作階段。⟦學校期中臨時更換書單時，下一堂課就會先發公告讓大家知道為何舊書停用，但修課中的班級還得重新開一次課程表才會整套換新。⟧
body.en:
When an administrator adds `managed-mcp.json` while a session is in progress, MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers stop loading. An explanatory message now appears on screen to tell you why the servers stopped.

Settings added mid-session like this may now take effect at the next check, though you still need to restart any currently open sessions for them to apply in full. ⟦When a school swaps its textbook list mid-semester, the next class gets an announcement explaining why the old books were dropped, though enrolled classes still need a fresh schedule to switch over completely.⟧

items.original:
Added a message explaining why MCP servers stop loading when an administrator adds `managed-mcp.json` during a session
Changed a `managed-mcp.json` added mid-session so it may apply at the next check; restart open sessions for it to apply in full

title.zh-TW: /mcp 連線狀態、取消等待與錯誤提示修復
title.en: Fixes for /mcp connection status, canceling waits, and error hints

body.zh-TW:
在終端機開啟 `/mcp`，本機標準輸出入 MCP 伺服器若啟動失敗，現在會顯示原因，不再只留一片空白。

伺服器重新連線期間，按 `Esc` 或連按兩次 `Ctrl+C` 可以先關閉等待畫面，重連會留在背景繼續跑。啟用慢速伺服器時也會顯示進度，再按一次 Enter 也不會誤關掉。

使用 `claude mcp add-json` 寫錯設定時，不再只回泛用的無效輸入訊息，而是直接指出該修改哪裡。
body.en:
When you open `/mcp` in the terminal and a local stdio MCP server fails to start, the reason is now shown instead of leaving a blank screen.

While a server is reconnecting, pressing `Esc` or pressing `Ctrl+C` twice closes the wait screen while the reconnect continues in the background. Enabling a slow server also shows progress, and pressing Enter a second time no longer disables it by mistake.

When you make a configuration mistake with `claude mcp add-json`, it no longer replies with a generic invalid input message and instead points out what to change.

items.original:
Fixed `/mcp` not showing why a local (stdio) MCP server failed to start
Fixed Esc doing nothing while an MCP server reconnects: Esc, or Ctrl+C pressed twice, now closes the wait and the reconnect continues in the background
Fixed Enable in `/mcp` showing no progress for a slow server, and a second Enter disabling it again
Fixed `claude mcp add-json` answering most mistakes with "Invalid configuration: : Invalid input"; it now says what to change

title.zh-TW: MCP 背景提問、複製連結與表單操作修復
title.en: Fixes for background MCP questions, copying links, and form navigation

body.zh-TW:
背景 MCP 任務跳出問題後，連按兩次 `Ctrl+C` 其實只是把問題留待稍後回答，現在提示文字不再誤寫成取消。

按 `c` 複製 MCP 登入網址時，貼上欄位裡不會再多出一個 `c` 字元。

填寫 MCP 伺服器的輸入表單時，現在可以用 `Tab` 與 `Shift+Tab` 在欄位間切換，把必填欄清空後也不會還留著勾選記號。
body.en:
When a background MCP task pops up a question, pressing `Ctrl+C` twice actually leaves the question to be answered later, so the hint text no longer mistakenly says "cancel".

Pressing `c` to copy an MCP sign-in URL no longer leaves an extra `c` character in the paste field.

When filling out an MCP server's input form, you can now use `Tab` and `Shift+Tab` to move between fields, and clearing a required field no longer leaves its checkmark behind.

items.original:
Fixed the Ctrl+C hint on a background MCP task's question saying "cancel" when the second press leaves the question to answer later
Fixed pressing `c` to copy an MCP sign-in URL leaving a stray `c` in the paste field
Fixed Tab and Shift+Tab not moving between fields in an MCP server's input form, and a required field there keeping its tick after being emptied

title.zh-TW: MCP 平行呼叫錯置與工具搜尋載入修復
title.en: Fixes for mixed-up parallel MCP calls and tool search loading

body.zh-TW:
同時呼叫多個 MCP 工具，若兩筆較長的結果在同一個毫秒抵達，過去會讀到另一通呼叫的結果，現在已經修好。

用精確名稱找工具時，過去偶爾會載入別台 MCP 伺服器的工具；現在已經修好，過程可能會再請你確認一次。兩台伺服器名稱很像時，提示詞也不會再突然消失。

支援多種參數格式分支的 MCP 工具，過去只給 Claude 看第一種格式，現在像 `42` 這類數值也能正確交給接收數字的分支。⟦在忙線的郵局櫃檯分信時，以前兩包大件同時到或收件人名字很像就容易塞錯格，現在每件包裹都能準確歸位。⟧
body.en:
When multiple MCP tools are called in parallel and two long results arrive in the same millisecond, reading one no longer picks up the other call's result.

Searching for a tool by its exact name previously occasionally loaded a tool from a different MCP server; that is now fixed, though you may be asked to confirm again during the process. When two servers have very similar names, prompts no longer disappear unexpectedly.

MCP tools that support multiple argument format branches previously showed Claude only the first format, whereas values like `42` can now be passed properly to a branch that accepts numbers. ⟦Sorting mail at a busy post office counter used to put items in the wrong cubby whenever two large parcels arrived at once or recipients had similar names, whereas now every package lands in its proper slot.⟧

items.original:
Fixed parallel MCP tool calls reading another call's saved result when two long results arrived in the same millisecond (anthropics/claude-code#105138)
Fixed tool search sometimes loading another MCP server's tool when asked for a tool by its exact name; you may be asked again for that tool
Fixed MCP prompts disappearing when two servers have nearly identical names
Fixed MCP tools with a root `anyOf` or `oneOf` showing Claude only the first branch's form of an argument; text such as `42` can now arrive as a number where another branch takes one

title.zh-TW: MCP 驗證失敗與雲端斷線的錯誤回報改善
title.en: Better error reporting for MCP auth failures and cloud disconnects

body.zh-TW:
沒有儲存 OAuth 更新用 token（授權令牌）的 MCP 伺服器，過去若 `headersHelper` 失敗或在未信任資料夾沒執行，會害其他工作階段也少掉這台伺服器。這個問題已經修好，其他工作階段不會再被波及。

給串接 SDK 的開發者：主機剛移除某台 MCP 伺服器後若收到工具呼叫，不再錯誤重連或要求驗證。

遠端 MCP 的提問被拒後工具失敗，或雲端工作單元換掉後工具不可用，現在都會通知 Claude。雲端工作階段經 Proxy 送出呼叫後若被切斷，也會告訴 Claude 結果未知。
body.en:
For MCP servers without a stored OAuth refresh token (an authorization credential), a failed `headersHelper` or one skipped in an untrusted folder previously caused other sessions to lose that server too. This is now fixed so other sessions are no longer affected.

For developers integrating the SDK: if a tool call arrives right after the host removes an MCP server, it no longer mistakenly reconnects or asks for authentication.

Claude is now notified if a remote MCP question is declined and the tool fails, or if a tool becomes unavailable after a cloud worker is replaced. If a cloud session is cut off after sending a call through its proxy, Claude is also told that the outcome is unknown.

items.original:
Fixed a failed MCP `headersHelper`, or one not run in an untrusted folder, making other sessions start without that server, for most servers with no stored OAuth refresh token
Fixed a tool call to an MCP server that an SDK host had just removed reconnecting to it, or reporting that it needs authentication
Fixed Claude not being told that a remote MCP server's question was declined when the server then failed the tool call
Fixed Claude not being told when an approved MCP resource tool was unavailable after a cloud session's worker was replaced
Improved MCP tool errors in cloud sessions: when a call through the session's proxy is cut off after it was sent, Claude is told that the outcome is unknown

title.zh-TW: 禁止工具誤寫登入檔與系統裝置檔案
title.en: Blocking tools from writing sign-in files and system device files

body.zh-TW:
保護登入憑證的安全限制收緊了。Claude 的檔案工具現在會直接拒絕寫入 `.credentials.json` 這類登入憑證檔。

Bash 權限檢查也提高警戒，更多指令想碰觸 Claude Code 的登入憑證檔前，都會先跳出來問你。

部分裝置檔與行程檔現在也列為檔案工具的拒絕存取對象，不會讓代理隨意讀寫。⟦把這想成幫放護照與身分證的抽屜加裝鎖頭，一般文書整理進不去，想伸手拿也得先當面問過你。⟧
body.en:
Security restrictions protecting sign-in credentials have been tightened. Claude's file tools now refuse writes to sign-in credential files such as `.credentials.json`.

The Bash permission check is also stricter, prompting you first before more commands can touch Claude Code's sign-in credential files.

Certain device and process files are now also blocked from file tools so the agent cannot read or write them freely. ⟦Think of it as putting a lock on the drawer holding your passport and ID, so routine paperwork stays out and anyone reaching inside has to ask you face to face first.⟧

items.original:
Changed Claude's file tools to refuse writes to Claude Code's sign-in files, such as `.credentials.json`
Changed the Bash permission check to ask before more commands reach Claude Code's sign-in files
Changed some file tools to refuse some device and process files

title.zh-TW: Bash、複製搬移與超長指令的權限把關更嚴
title.en: Stricter permission checks for Bash, copy/move, and oversized commands

body.zh-TW:
Bash 權限檢查現在會先詢問更多指令，無人能回應時就直接拒絕；macOS 上部分過去直接放行的 Bash 指令也改為詢問或拒絕。

部分 `cp` 與 `mv` 指令現在執行前也會先問過你。即使切到略過權限模式，部分工具呼叫仍會要求核准，無人回應就拒絕。

遇到指令值太長、Bash 權限檢查來不及讀完的情況，現在也會先詢問；若可能觸及拒絕規則或無人回應，就會直接攔下。
body.en:
The Bash permission check now asks first for more commands and refuses them when no one can answer; some Bash commands on macOS that previously ran directly now ask or are refused as well.

Some `cp` and `mv` commands now ask you before running. Even in bypass permissions mode, certain tool calls still require approval and are denied if no one answers.

When a command has values too long for the Bash permission check to finish reading, it now asks first as well, and blocks the command if a deny rule may apply or no one can answer.

items.original:
Improved Bash permission checks: some commands now ask first, or are refused where no one can answer
Changed some Bash commands on macOS that ran before to ask or be refused
Changed some `cp` and `mv` commands to ask first
Changed some tool calls in bypass permissions mode to ask for approval, or be denied where no one can be asked
Changed the Bash permission check to ask about some commands with very long values it can't finish checking, or to refuse them where a deny rule may apply or no one can answer

title.zh-TW: 修正 Bash 檔案操作誤判與誤報危險提示
title.en: Fix Bash file operation misreads and false danger warnings

body.zh-TW:
用 `cp` 複製檔案，過去只要來源檔受 `Edit` 拒絕規則限制就會整筆被拒，現在已經修好。Bash 裡的 `grep` 也不再默默漏掉部分純文字檔。

對話紀錄過去會把 `find -delete`、`cat a > b` 或 `sort -o` 這類刪寫檔指令誤記成搜尋或讀取，現在不再歸錯類。

有些不含 `rm` 但 Claude Code 讀不太準的指令，也不會再誤跳「Dangerous rm operation」的誤導警告了。
body.en:
Copying a file with `cp` used to be refused entirely whenever the source file was covered by an `Edit` deny rule; that is now fixed. `grep` in Bash also no longer silently skips some plain-text files.

Transcripts used to mislabel file-deleting or overwriting commands like `find -delete`, `cat a > b`, or `sort -o` as a search or a read, and now categorize them properly.

Some commands without `rm` that Claude Code cannot read reliably will no longer trigger the misleading "Dangerous rm operation" warning.

items.original:
Fixed `cp` of a file being refused when only its source was covered by an `Edit` deny rule
Fixed Bash commands that delete or overwrite files (`find -delete`, `cat a > b`, `sort -o`) being summed up in the transcript as a search or a read
Fixed a misleading "Dangerous rm operation" warning in the Bash permission prompt on some commands with no rm that Claude Code can't read reliably
Fixed `grep` in the Bash tool silently skipping some text files

title.zh-TW: PowerShell 工具收緊詢問條件與函式限制
title.en: Tighter prompts and function limits for the PowerShell tool

body.zh-TW:
Windows 常用到的 PowerShell 工具，現在在更多指令執行前會先問你；無人看守的執行除非有放行規則、auto mode 或略過權限模式允許，否則會直接拒絕。

部分指令現在甚至連略過權限模式都會要求詢問，或直接拒絕。語法有誤的 PowerShell 指令也會直接被拒。

若指令裡定義的函式與內建指令撞名，現在同樣會被擋下，讓 Claude 改名後再試。⟦打個比方，工場規定扳手不能跟電鑽貼同一個名字，碰到危險動作就算領過免檢證照樣要複驗。⟧
body.en:
The PowerShell tool commonly used on Windows now asks before running more commands; unattended runs refuse them unless an allow rule, auto mode, or bypass permissions mode allows them.

Some commands now ask for confirmation even in bypass permissions mode, or get refused outright. Malformed PowerShell commands are also denied.

If a command defines a function with the same name as a built-in command, it is now blocked as well so Claude can rename it and try again. ⟦In a workshop where wrenches cannot share a label with power drills, risky moves still require a second check even if you hold an inspection-exempt pass.⟧

items.original:
Changed the PowerShell tool to ask before some more commands; unattended runs refuse them unless an allow rule, auto mode or bypass permissions mode allows them
Changed the PowerShell tool to ask about some more commands, even in bypass permissions mode, and to refuse some of them
Changed some malformed PowerShell commands to be denied
Changed some PowerShell tool commands that define a function named like a built-in command to be refused, so Claude can rename it

title.zh-TW: macOS 電腦操作權限面板停用 j 與 k 鍵
title.en: Disable j and k keys in the macOS computer use permissions panel

body.zh-TW: 替電腦操作功能在 macOS 上授權、挑選要開的項目，現在按 `j` 和 `k` 不會再移動游標。要上下切換，改用方向鍵或 `Ctrl+P`、`Ctrl+N` 即可。
body.en: When granting permissions and picking items to enable for computer use on macOS, pressing `j` and `k` no longer moves the cursor. Use the arrow keys or `Ctrl+P` and `Ctrl+N` to move up and down instead.

items.original: Changed the computer use macOS permissions panel to ignore j and k; the arrow keys and Ctrl+P/Ctrl+N still move the selection

title.zh-TW: Bash 沙盒限縮家目錄寫入並強化隔離
title.en: Restrict home folder writes and strengthen Bash sandbox isolation

body.zh-TW:
macOS、Linux 與 WSL 的 Bash 沙盒保護現在更嚴密了。同一個工作階段裡，沙盒在部分情況下會先維持狀態，直到你跑 `/sandbox` 或 `/cd`；期間 Bash 可能會先詢問。

沙盒指令在 macOS、Linux 與 WSL 預設不再寫入部分敏感家目錄資料夾；真有需要，可在使用者或管理設定檔的 `sandbox` 區塊透過 `filesystem` 的 `allowWrite` 放行部分路徑。

關閉自動放行時，碰到設定環境變數的指令列也會先詢問，無人看守的執行則可能直接拒絕。⟦沙盒像替工人圍起臨時施工區，沒有開通行證就不能踏進住家書房，中途也不會隨便拆掉圍籬。⟧
body.en:
Bash sandbox protections on macOS, Linux, and WSL are now tighter. Within the same session, the sandbox keeps its state in some cases until you run `/sandbox` or `/cd`; during that time, Bash may ask first.

Sandboxed commands on macOS, Linux, and WSL no longer write to some sensitive home folders by default; if needed, specific paths can be allowed via `allowWrite` under `filesystem` in the `sandbox` section of user or managed settings.

When auto-allow is off, command lines that set environment variables also prompt first, while unattended runs may refuse them. ⟦Workers inside a temporary work zone cannot step into the home study without an entry pass, and the fence is never casually taken down mid-job.⟧

items.original:
Improved Bash sandbox protections on macOS, Linux and WSL
Changed the Bash sandbox to keep its state in some cases during a session, until you run `/sandbox` or `/cd`; Bash may ask first
Changed sandboxed commands on macOS, Linux and WSL to no longer write to some sensitive home folders by default; some can be allowed with `sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite` in user or managed settings
Changed the Bash sandbox to ask before some lines that set environment variables when auto-allow is off; unattended runs can refuse them

title.zh-TW: 沙盒調整 .git、新增目錄與 /rewind 行為
title.en: Sandbox updates for .git, new folders, and /rewind

body.zh-TW:
沙盒內的指令跑完後，若儲存庫的 `.git` 資料夾出現預期外的項目，Bash 沙盒現在會把它另外移開。

在 Linux 與 WSL，若 `--add-dir` 指定的資料夾還不存在，沙盒會在每次指令前先建好，因此原本打算自己建該資料夾的指令可能失敗、略過或改寫進裡面。

在 macOS、Linux 與 WSL 開啟沙盒時，執行 `/rewind` 會保留部分檔案不動，並回報這些檔案已被略過。
body.en:
After a sandboxed command finishes, the Bash sandbox now sets aside any unexpected entries that appear in the repository's `.git` folder.

On Linux and WSL, if a folder specified by `--add-dir` does not exist yet, the sandbox creates it before each command, so commands that meant to create that folder themselves may fail, skip, or write inside it instead.

When the sandbox is on in macOS, Linux, and WSL, running `/rewind` leaves some files untouched and reports them as skipped.

items.original:
Changed the Bash sandbox to set aside unexpected entries in a repository's `.git` folder after a command
Changed the Bash sandbox on Linux and WSL to create some missing `--add-dir` folders before each sandboxed command, so commands that create them can fail, skip, or land inside them
Changed `/rewind` on macOS, Linux and WSL to leave some files untouched and report them as skipped when the sandbox is on

title.zh-TW: 權限改寫與 claude mcp serve 的沙盒調整
title.en: Sandbox changes for rewritten permissions and claude mcp serve

body.zh-TW:
給寫權限 hook 或串接 SDK 的開發者：原本受沙盒檢查的指令，就算在核准過程中被改寫，現在仍會留在沙盒裡執行；核准端必須主動加上停用沙盒的設定才會放行。

執行 `claude mcp serve` 時，現在會忽略 `sandbox` 設定區塊底下的 `excludedCommands`。
body.en:
For developers writing permission hooks or integrating the SDK: commands originally checked as sandboxed now stay in the sandbox even if rewritten during approval; the approver must explicitly add the setting to disable the sandbox to allow bypassing it.

Running `claude mcp serve` now ignores `excludedCommands` under the `sandbox` settings block.

items.original:
Changed commands that a permission hook or SDK host rewrites while approving to stay in the sandbox if the original was checked as sandboxed; the approver can add `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true`
Changed `claude mcp serve` to ignore `sandbox.excludedCommands`

title.zh-TW: 修正 Linux 沙盒捷徑啟動與殘留鎖定檔
title.en: Fix Linux sandbox symlink startup and leftover lock files

body.zh-TW:
在 Linux 上，家目錄或設定目錄若透過 symlink（符號連結，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）連進 `/net`，又被沙盒禁止讀取，過去會啟動失敗。這個問題已經修好，指令現在能正常啟動。

沙盒指令執行到一半被中止時，專案裡偶爾會留下 `.git/config.lock` 這類空白佔位檔，現在也不會再殘留。

Linux 沙盒給 Claude 的指引也更明確，會說明啟動的伺服器只能從同一道指令連線。
body.en:
On Linux, if the home or config directory points into `/net` through a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) and sandbox settings deny reading it, commands used to fail to start. That issue is fixed, and commands now start normally.

When a sandboxed command is stopped partway through, empty placeholder files like `.git/config.lock` no longer get left behind in the project.

Linux sandbox instructions for Claude are also clearer, explaining that a started server is only reachable from the same command.

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when the home or config directory is reached through a symlink into `/net` and sandbox settings deny reads of it
Fixed empty placeholder files, including `.git/config.lock`, sometimes being left in the project on Linux when Claude Code was stopped during a sandboxed command
Improved Claude's sandbox instructions on Linux to explain that a server is reachable only from the command that started it

title.zh-TW: 功能被供應商或環境變數停用時會說原因
title.en: Explain why features are disabled by provider or environment variables

body.zh-TW:
以前輸入某些指令只會看到「Unknown command」，看不出它為什麼不能用。

現在輸入這類被停用的指令時，終端機不會再冷冷回你「Unknown command」，而是會直接告訴你停用原因，例如登入方式、供應商，或 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` 這類環境變數。

想一次看清哪些功能被關掉，輸入 `/status` 也會多出一列，專門標明是什麼原因停用了它們。⟦去自動販賣機按飲料沒反應時，以前只亮紅燈，現在螢幕會直接寫明是哪條電路被開關關掉。⟧
body.en:
Previously, entering certain commands only showed "Unknown command" without explaining why they were unavailable.

Now when you enter one of these disabled commands, the terminal no longer bluntly replies "Unknown command" and instead tells you why it is off, such as your sign-in method, provider, or an environment variable like `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`.

To see all disabled features at a glance, `/status` also adds a row that specifically states what turned them off. ⟦At a vending machine where pressing a drink button does nothing, it used to only flash a red light; now the screen spells out which circuit switch was turned off.⟧

items.original:
Added a row to `/status` that says when your provider or an environment variable such as `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` turns features off
Improved commands that are off for your provider, sign-in or an environment variable such as `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` to say why instead of "Unknown command"

title.zh-TW: 修正 /login 與 /status 的帳號金鑰判斷
title.en: Fix account and key detection in /login and /status

body.zh-TW:
在 `/login` 選擇用 Console 主控台帳號登入，若瀏覽器裡改用 Claude 訂閱方案登入，過去會不小心蓋掉原本的訂閱登入狀態，現在已經修好。

當核准使用的 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 還在生效時，`/login` 不會再只顯示「Login successful」，而是會提醒請求仍在使用這把金鑰。

在 `/config` 開啟 API 金鑰後，畫面不會再卡在「Not logged in」。未登入提示、`/login` 與 `/status` 現在也都會點名尚未使用的 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`。
body.en:
Choosing to sign in with a Console account in `/login` used to accidentally overwrite your existing Claude subscription login if you signed in with your Claude plan in the browser; that is now fixed.

When an approved `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is still active, `/login` no longer ends on just "Login successful" and instead reminds you that requests still use this key.

After turning on the API key in `/config`, the screen no longer stays stuck on "Not logged in". The not-logged-in prompt, `/login`, and `/status` now also name an unused `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

items.original:
Fixed "Sign in with your Console account" in `/login` replacing your Claude subscription login when the browser sign-in used your Claude plan instead of a Console organization
Fixed `/login` ending on "Login successful" while an approved `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` was still used; it now says requests still use the key
Fixed "Not logged in" staying after turning on the API key in `/config`; "Not logged in", `/login` and `/status` now name an unused `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`

title.zh-TW: 登出清除憑證與代理恢復的帳號歸屬修復
title.en: Fix logout credential cleanup and agent resume sign-in attribution

body.zh-TW:
終端機裡的 `/logout` 與 `claude auth logout` 現在會重試撤銷登入，若伺服器沒確認，也會告訴你去哪裡手動撤銷。

當只有 Console 主控台設定檔的登入憑證放在不支援資料夾時間戳記的磁碟上時，`claude auth logout` 不會再漏刪憑證，token 刷新也不會跟著失敗。

從代理檢視恢復舊對話時，若背景服務沒有終端機的 API 金鑰或 token，現在不再誤用背景服務自己的登入身分送出請求。
body.en:
`/logout` and `claude auth logout` in the terminal now retry revoking the login, and if the server does not confirm, they tell you where to revoke it manually.

When only a Console profile's login credentials are stored on a drive that does not support folder timestamps, `claude auth logout` no longer leaves credentials behind, and token refresh no longer fails along with it.

When resuming a past conversation from agent view, if the background service does not have the terminal's API key or token, it no longer mistakenly sends requests under the background service's own sign-in.

items.original:
Fixed `claude auth logout` leaving credentials behind, and token refresh failing, when only a Console profile's credentials are on a drive that rejects folder timestamps
Fixed a past conversation resumed from agent view being sent on the background service's sign-in when the service doesn't have the terminal's API key or token
Improved `/logout` and `claude auth logout` in the terminal to retry revoking the login, and to say where to revoke it if the server doesn't confirm

title.zh-TW: 驗證逾時重試與憑證、封鎖錯誤提示改善
title.en: Auth timeout retries and clearer certificate and block error messages

body.zh-TW:
在 Claude Desktop 的 Code 分頁送出模型請求，若遇到單次 401 驗證錯誤，現在會先自動重送一次，不會立刻失敗。

遇到網路封鎖頁回傳 HTTP 403 而觸發 `forceLoginOrgUUID` 或 `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` 錯誤時，不再誤叫你重新登入。

憑證簽章無法驗證時，Desktop 的 Code 分頁不再怪罪網路連線。遇到 `CERT_SIGNATURE_FAILURE` 錯誤時，還會說明可能是更新根憑證所致，並提示 IT 可調整的方向。
body.en:
When sending a model request in Claude Desktop's Code tab, a single 401 authentication error now triggers one automatic retry instead of failing right away.

When a network block page returns HTTP 403 and triggers `forceLoginOrgUUID` or `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` errors, it no longer mistakenly tells you to sign in again.

When a certificate signature cannot be verified, Desktop's Code tab no longer blames the internet connection. On `CERT_SIGNATURE_FAILURE` errors, it also notes that a root certificate renewal may be the cause and points to what IT can adjust.

items.original:
Fixed model requests failing on a one-off authentication error (401) in Claude Desktop's Code tab: they are now sent once more first
Fixed `forceLoginOrgUUID` and `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` startup errors telling you to sign in again when a network block page (HTTP 403) was the cause
Fixed Claude Desktop's Code tab blaming the internet connection when a certificate's signature couldn't be verified
Improved the `CERT_SIGNATURE_FAILURE` connection error to name a possible cause after a CA renewal and what IT can change

title.zh-TW: /login 貼碼防呆與登入流程改善
title.en: /login paste safeguards and sign-in flow improvements

body.zh-TW:
用 `claude auth login` 貼登入碼，畫面現在看得到貼上的內容，貼錯可以先改再按 Enter。`/login` 與 `claude setup-token` 送出後也會顯示「Finishing sign-in…」。

登入提示誤貼了驗證碼或網址時，會直接告訴你該改貼什麼，且畫面不會跳掉；`/login` 改用標準輸入框、錯誤原因直接列在下方，小視窗也會捲動到看得到欄位。

API 拒絕 Console 主控台登入時，錯誤訊息會改請你執行 `/login`，不再指向管理員設定。⟦到銀行自動櫃員機輸入密碼時，以前按錯就直接退卡，現在會留在原畫面提醒哪一欄不對，改好就能繼續。⟧
body.en:
When pasting a sign-in code in `claude auth login`, the screen now shows what you pasted so you can fix mistakes before pressing Enter. After submitting in `/login` and `claude setup-token`, it also shows "Finishing sign-in…".

If you paste a verification code or web address at a sign-in prompt by mistake, it tells you what to paste instead without dismissing the prompt. `/login` now uses a standard text field with rejection reasons listed right below it, and short windows scroll the field into view.

When the API refuses a Console sign-in, the error message now tells you to run `/login` instead of pointing to an admin setting. ⟦Entering a PIN at a bank ATM used to eject your card on a mistake, but now it keeps you on the same screen, highlights which field is wrong, and lets you proceed once fixed.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude auth login` not showing a pasted sign-in code, so a wrong paste couldn't be seen or corrected before Enter
Fixed `/login` and `claude setup-token` showing nothing after you submit a pasted code; they now show "Finishing sign-in…"
Improved the error shown when the API refuses a Console sign-in: it now says to run `/login` instead of pointing to an admin setting
Improved sign-in prompts: pasting a verification code or a web address now says what to do instead, and the prompt stays so you can paste the right code (anthropics/claude-code#97)
Improved the `/login` screen: the code goes in a proper text field, a rejected code says why under it, and pasting in a short window scrolls the field into view

title.zh-TW: 各指令與閘道登入畫面對齊 /login 體驗
title.en: Command and gateway sign-in screens aligned with /login

body.zh-TW:
執行 `/design-login`、`/install-github-app` 與 MCP 登入，介面現在都跟 `/login` 一樣好操作。前兩者在貼上登入碼時，還會把內容遮罩起來保護隱私。

而在 Claude 應用程式閘道登入畫面中，登入網址現在直接變成可點擊的連結，按一下 `c` 就能快速複製網址。
body.en:
Running `/design-login`, `/install-github-app`, and MCP sign-in now gives you the same smooth experience as `/login`. The first two also mask the pasted sign-in code for privacy.

On the Claude apps gateway sign-in screens, the sign-in address is now a clickable link, and pressing `c` quickly copies it.

items.original:
Improved `/design-login`, `/install-github-app` and MCP sign-in screens to match `/login`; the first two now mask the pasted code
Improved the Claude apps gateway sign-in screens: the sign-in address is a link and `c` copies it

title.zh-TW: 修正初次啟動、登入與登出時的按鍵異常
title.en: Key-handling fixes for first run, sign-in, and sign-out

body.zh-TW:
初次啟動等待瀏覽器登入或貼上驗證碼，按 `Esc` 現在可以退回上一個畫面，不再完全沒反應。

在全螢幕模式執行 `/logout` 離開後，畫面上現在會保留已登出的訊息，不會空空如也。

在登入或設定步驟連按 `Ctrl+C` 或 `Ctrl+D` 離開後，Shell 提示字元不再疊印在最後一個畫面上。

初次挑選主題或遇到背景工作階段的啟動提問時，連按兩次 `Ctrl+C` 也不會再沒反應或卡死終端機。
body.en:
While first-run sign-in waits for the browser or a pasted code, pressing `Esc` now goes back one screen instead of doing nothing.

After running `/logout` in fullscreen mode, the screen now keeps the logged-out message visible instead of exiting blank.

After quitting a sign-in or setup step with `Ctrl+C` or `Ctrl+D`, the shell prompt is no longer drawn over the last screen.

Pressing `Ctrl+C` twice during the first-run theme choice or at a background session's startup question no longer does nothing or freezes the terminal.

items.original:
Fixed Esc doing nothing while the first-run sign-in waits for the browser or a pasted code; it now goes back one screen
Fixed `/logout` in fullscreen mode exiting without leaving the logged-out message on screen
Fixed the shell prompt being drawn over the last screen after quitting with Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D at a sign-in or first-run step
Fixed Ctrl+C twice doing nothing on the first-run theme choice, and freezing the terminal on setup screens or a background session at its startup question

title.zh-TW: 修正 /privacy-settings 切換與多帳號錯存
title.en: /privacy-settings toggle and multi-account save fixes

body.zh-TW:
在 `/privacy-settings` 或啟動時拒絕更新條款，儲存期間誤按按鍵不會再把你的關閉選擇蓋掉。

快速連按兩次切換開關時，不會再出現畫面與實際存檔相反的狀況；按 `Esc` 後誤觸按鍵也不會改到設定，存檔失敗時則會明確通知。

若在另一個終端機切換登入帳號，`/privacy-settings` 不會存錯帳號；先開再關時也不會誤顯示已設為開啟。
body.en:
When declining updated terms in `/privacy-settings` or at startup, keys pressed while saving no longer overwrite your OFF choice.

A quick double press on the toggle no longer saves the opposite of what the screen shows. Pressing keys after `Esc` no longer changes your setting either, and failed saves now notify you clearly.

If you switch accounts in another terminal, `/privacy-settings` no longer saves to the wrong account, and picking OFF right after ON no longer wrongly shows it as enabled.

items.original:
Fixed your OFF answer to the updated terms being replaced when keys were typed while it was saving, at startup and in `/privacy-settings`
Fixed the `/privacy-settings` toggle sometimes saving the opposite of what the screen showed on a quick double press, changing your setting on keys pressed after Esc, and not saying when a save failed
Fixed `/privacy-settings` saving your choice on the wrong account after signing in to a different account in another terminal
Fixed `/privacy-settings` saying "set to true" when you picked OFF right after ON

title.zh-TW: 用量上限選單防誤觸與額度重置提示改善
title.en: Usage limit menu safeguards and budget reset notices

body.zh-TW:
開啟支出上限選單後，剛打開就按 `Backspace` 和 `Enter` 不再默默清掉每月上限；用量上限選單也不會在你打字中途突然跳出來清光草稿。

用量上限重置後，舊上限訊息底下不會再跳出升級提示。團隊共用額度用盡時，訊息現在會寫明額度何時重置。

執行 `/usage-credits` 被拒時，若你自己就有帳務權限，畫面會改引導你前往用量設定頁，不再一律顯示已送交管理員。
body.en:
Pressing `Backspace` and `Enter` right as the spend limit menu opens no longer silently clears your monthly limit. The usage limit menu also no longer pops up while you are typing and wipes your draft.

After a usage limit resets, an upgrade hint no longer appears under old limit messages. When a team's pooled budget runs out, the message now states when the budget resets.

When `/usage-credits` is refused and you have billing access yourself, the screen now points you to the usage settings page instead of always saying the request was sent to your admin.

items.original:
Fixed the spend limit menu removing the monthly limit without asking when Backspace and Enter were pressed as it opened
Fixed the usage limit menu erasing your draft and opening while you were typing
Fixed `/usage-credits` saying "Request sent to your admin" when the request was refused; people who have billing access themselves are now pointed to the usage settings page
Fixed an upgrade hint appearing under an old usage limit message after the limit had reset
Improved the message shown when a team's pooled group budget is used up: it now says when the budget resets

title.zh-TW: 額度等待中變更登入與 /usage 順序調整
title.en: Login changes while waiting on limits and /usage order

body.zh-TW:
設定「達用量上限時自動繼續」後，如果在等待期間切換帳號或登出，Claude Code 現在會跳出通知並直接停止，不會繼續送出任何請求。

訂閱用戶在全螢幕模式輸入 `/usage` 時，現在會先看到方案用量長條圖，再看到工作階段花費；想先看花費，輸入 `/cost` 就好。

使用額外用量點數計費的回覆結束後，Claude Code 不再自動送出工作階段回顧，需要時手動輸入 `/recap` 就能看。
body.en:
With "Continue automatically at usage limit" enabled, switching accounts or signing out during the wait now makes Claude Code show a notice and stop immediately without sending any requests.

For subscribers running `/usage` in fullscreen mode, plan limit bars now appear before session cost. If you want to see cost first, run `/cost` instead.

After a reply billed to usage credits finishes, Claude Code no longer sends an automatic session recap; you can still run `/recap` manually when needed.

items.original:
Changed "Continue automatically at usage limit" to stop with a notice, sending nothing, when your login changes or ends during the wait
Changed `/usage` in fullscreen mode to show plan limit bars before session cost for subscribers; `/cost` still starts with cost
Fixed the automatic session recap being sent after a reply billed to usage credits; `/recap` still works

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 支援即時串流與連線調整
title.en: Remote Control live streaming and connection updates

body.zh-TW:
打開遠端遙控後，`claude remote-control`、Claude Desktop 與 VS Code 的工作階段回覆，現在會邊寫邊串流到手機或瀏覽器。你不用等到整段跑完才看得到內容。

連線經由 Proxy 時，Remote Control 改用 CONNECT 通道送出請求；若 Proxy 拒絕 CONNECT，會直接報錯停止。

開啟 `--verbose` 產生的遠端工作階段除錯紀錄，現在會改存到 `~/.claude/child-logs/`。⟦看體育比賽的即時文字轉播時，不用等整場結束發新聞稿，現場每打一行字，手機就馬上跳出來。⟧
body.en:
With Remote Control enabled, session replies from `claude remote-control`, Claude Desktop, and VS Code now stream to your phone or browser as they are written. You no longer have to wait for the full response to finish.

When connecting through a proxy, Remote Control now sends requests over a CONNECT tunnel, and stops with an error if the proxy refuses CONNECT.

Remote session debug logs generated under `--verbose` are now saved to `~/.claude/child-logs/`. ⟦Following a live text play-by-play of a sports match means each line typed at the venue pops up on your phone right away instead of waiting for a post-game press release.⟧

items.original:
Improved Remote Control: replies from `claude remote-control`, Claude Desktop and VS Code sessions now stream to your phone or browser as they are written
Remote Control: Changed how it connects through a proxy: requests now use a CONNECT tunnel, so a proxy that refuses CONNECT stops Remote Control with an error
Remote Control: Changed the session debug logs written under `--verbose` to go to `~/.claude/child-logs/`

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 狀態、QR Code 與中止修復
title.en: Remote Control status, QR code, and Stop fixes

body.zh-TW:
伺服器短暫無回應時，Remote Control 工作階段不會再於回覆寫到一半斷線。在 80×24 這類較矮的終端機視窗，`/remote-control` 的 QR Code 也不再被截斷。

背景子代理還在跑時，手機端不再誤顯示為待機，在手機或網頁按 Stop 會連同子代理一起停掉。

遇到只能在終端機回答的提示，或工具執行中才開遙控時，狀態也不會再顛倒顯示；重啟期間按過 Stop，重開後不會又自己續跑。
body.en:
Remote Control sessions no longer disconnect mid-reply when the server is briefly unavailable. In short terminal windows such as 80×24, the `/remote-control` QR code is no longer cut off either.

While background subagents are still running, your phone no longer wrongly shows the session as idle, and pressing Stop on your phone or the web ends the subagents too.

Status is no longer inverted when waiting on a prompt that can only be answered in the terminal or when turning on Remote Control while a tool is running. Pressing Stop during a restart also prevents the reply from resuming on its own afterward.

items.original:
Remote Control: Fixed a session disconnecting mid-reply when the server was briefly unavailable
Remote Control: Fixed the QR code in `/remote-control` being cut off in short terminal windows such as 80×24
Remote Control: Fixed terminal sessions showing as idle on your phone while background subagents were still running; Stop on your phone or the web now ends them together with the turn
Fixed Remote Control showing a session as running while it waited on a prompt that can only be answered in the terminal, and as idle when turned on while a tool was running
Fixed a reply in a remote session running again after a restart when Stop had been pressed while Claude Code was restarting

title.zh-TW: 雲端與遠端傳檔重試、檔案保留與通知遮罩
title.en: Cloud and remote file upload retries, preservation, and notification masking

body.zh-TW:
在未載入任何功能旗標的 Linux 環境中，遠端或雲端工作階段若重送同名檔案，不再直接蓋掉 Claude 改過的版本；舊檔會移到 `.kept-` 資料夾，或選擇不存新檔。

Claude 從雲端或 Remote Control 傳送檔案時，若碰到 Proxy 回傳 HTTP 502、504 或 520 到 524 錯誤，現在會再重試一次，不會立刻失敗。

遠端與雲端工作的推播通知也強化了敏感資訊遮罩；經遙控從終端機要求使用 Chrome 擴充時，claude.ai 就算已核准該網站，仍會明確顯示網站名稱。
body.en:
On Linux with no feature flags loaded, re-sending a file with the same name in Remote Control or cloud sessions no longer overwrites Claude's edited copy; the old copy moves to a `.kept-` folder, or the new file is not saved.

When Claude sends files from cloud or Remote Control sessions and a proxy responds with HTTP 502, 504, or 520 to 524, it now retries once instead of failing immediately.

Push notifications from Remote Control and cloud sessions also have stronger secret masking. When requesting Chrome extension access from a terminal session over Remote Control, claude.ai still names the site clearly even if it is already allowed.

items.original:
Fixed a re-sent file overwriting Claude's changed copy in Remote Control and cloud sessions on Linux with no feature flags loaded: the copy moves to a `.kept-` folder, or the new file isn't saved
Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing at once when a proxy answers an upload with its own HTTP 502, 504 or 520 to 524; the upload now gets a second try
Improved how secrets are masked in push notifications from Remote Control and cloud sessions
Improved Claude in Chrome permission requests from a terminal session over Remote Control: on claude.ai they now name the site Claude wants to act on, also when it is already allowed

title.zh-TW: claude.ai 與 Cowork 傳檔金鑰檢查修復
title.en: Fixes for file-sending key checks in claude.ai and Cowork

body.zh-TW:
在 claude.ai 對話或 Cowork 任務傳送檔案，跳出私密金鑰檢查後就算你點了「Send it」，過去仍可能沒把檔案送出去，現在已經修好。

遇到裡面包著 Word、Excel 或其他壓縮格式的外掛檔時，介面不再只因為格式就反覆詢問，而是會先實際讀取內容確認有沒有金鑰。
body.en:
Fixed an issue where sending a file in a claude.ai chat or Cowork task could still fail to send even after you clicked "Send it" at the secret key check.

When a plugin file contains a Word, Excel, or other compressed file, the interface no longer prompts repeatedly just because of the format, and instead reads the contents first to check for keys.

items.original:
Fixed claude.ai chats and Cowork tasks sometimes not sending a file after you chose "Send it" at the check for secret keys
Fixed claude.ai chats and Cowork tasks asking about a plugin file only because it holds a Word, Excel or other zip-type file; such files are now read for secret keys first

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器權限收緊與內建 gh api 調整
title.en: Tighter self-hosted runner permissions and built-in gh api updates

body.zh-TW:
用 `claude self-hosted-runner` 時，若機器時間跑得比實際快而讓更新 token 看起來已過期，過去會陷入不停要新 token 的死循環，現在已經修好。

在 `--trust-workspace false` 模式下，自架執行器現在會忽略更多儲存庫本身的設定，有需要的設定請改寫在使用者或組織管理設定裡。

Linux 與 macOS 工作階段若沒有 `gh`，預設會經 Anthropic 提供內建 `gh api`，有登入時會帶入你的 GitHub 帳號。想關閉這項預設，執行時加上 `--use-anthropic-gh false` 即可。
body.en:
Fixed an infinite loop when using `claude self-hosted-runner` where it kept requesting new tokens nonstop if the machine's clock ran ahead and made a refreshed token look expired.

Under `--trust-workspace false`, self-hosted runners now ignore more repository settings; put any needed settings in user or organization managed settings instead.

If `gh` is missing in Linux and macOS sessions, a built-in `gh api` is now provided via Anthropic by default, using your GitHub sign-in if you are logged in. To turn this default off, run with `--use-anthropic-gh false`.

items.original:
Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` asking for new tokens nonstop when a refreshed token was already due, such as when the machine's clock runs ahead
Changed self-hosted runners under `--trust-workspace false` to ignore more repository settings; set such values in user or managed settings
Self-hosted runner: Changed Linux and macOS sessions with no `gh` to get a built-in `gh api` by default, via Anthropic, which adds their GitHub sign-in, if any; `--use-anthropic-gh false` turns it off

title.zh-TW: 雲端中止加速與遠端「永遠允許」儲存調整
title.en: Faster cloud stop and remote "always allow" saving updates

body.zh-TW:
在雲端或自架執行器工作階段按下 Stop 時，過去偶爾會卡著等緩慢的 MCP 伺服器連上線才真的停下來，這個問題已經修好，現在能更快中止。

透過 Remote Control 或自架執行器回覆權限請求時，調整了選擇「永遠允許」後的儲存方式。
body.en:
Fixed an issue where pressing Stop in cloud or self-hosted runner sessions could occasionally hang waiting for slow MCP servers to connect before actually stopping, so it now aborts faster.

Adjusted how "always allow" choices are saved when answering permission requests through Remote Control or on self-hosted runners.

items.original:
Fixed Stop in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions sometimes waiting for slow MCP servers to connect before taking effect
Changed how permission answers over Remote Control and on self-hosted runners save "always allow" choices

title.zh-TW: /autofix-pr、/teleport 與跨機傳訊調整
title.en: Updates to /autofix-pr, /teleport, and cross-machine messaging

body.zh-TW:
使用 `/autofix-pr` 若遇到無法停止的雲端工作階段，現在不再誤報為已取消，而是附上該工作階段連結讓你自己手動停掉。

在寬度較窄的終端機裡開啟 `/teleport` 時，清單裡的工作階段不會再被隱藏起來。

如果你在保留舊 claude.ai 登入狀態的同時改用 API 金鑰、驗證 token、設定檔或工作負載身分，Claude 現在會拒絕把訊息送到另一台機器上的工作階段。
body.en:
When `/autofix-pr` hits a cloud session that cannot be stopped, it no longer falsely reports the run as cancelled and instead includes a link to the session so you can stop it manually.

Opening `/teleport` in narrow terminals no longer hides sessions from the list.

If you switch to an API key, auth token, profile, or workload identity while keeping an older claude.ai login saved, Claude now refuses to send messages to a session on another machine.

items.original:
Fixed `/autofix-pr` reporting a run as cancelled when its cloud session could not be stopped; it now links the session so you can stop it
Fixed `/teleport` hiding a session from its list in narrow terminals
Changed Claude's messages to a session on another machine to be refused when your session uses an API key, auth token, profile or workload identity beside a saved claude.ai login

title.zh-TW: 產出物發布權限、存取說明與連結顯示修復
title.en: Fixes for artifact publishing permissions, access labels, and link display

body.zh-TW:
發佈產出物時，放在背景工作階段暫存資料夾裡的檔案過去會被拒絕，現在可以正常發佈。終端機在 Claude 發佈或更新產出物後，也會確實印出連結。

部分雲端工作階段裡，就算子代理的 `disallowedTools` 明確禁用了 `Artifact`，過去還是會拿到產出物工具，現在已經修好。

剛發佈的產出物只要資料夾有權限的人都能開，Claude 也不會再誤說它是私密的。
body.en:
Files in a background session's temporary folder are no longer refused when publishing artifacts. The terminal also properly prints the link after Claude publishes or updates an artifact.

Fixed an issue in some cloud sessions where subagents still received artifact tools even when `Artifact` was explicitly listed in `disallowedTools`.

Anyone with access to the folder can open a just-published artifact, and Claude no longer mistakenly calls it private.

items.original:
Fixed artifact publishing refusing files in a background session's temporary folder
Fixed subagents whose `disallowedTools` lists `Artifact` still being offered artifact tools in some cloud sessions
Fixed Claude calling a just-published artifact private when people with access to its folder can open it
Fixed the terminal not showing an artifact's link after Claude publishes or updates it

title.zh-TW: Worktree 建立進度與離開統計修復
title.en: Fixes for worktree setup progress and exit counts

body.zh-TW:
用 `claude --worktree` 開啟 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，建立較慢現在會顯示進度。畫面不會再一片空白讓你乾等。

關閉 worktree 的離開確認視窗時，新建的資料夾不再被算成一個未提交檔案。

部分 worktree 工作階段會略過某些外掛設定，畫面也會明確列出被略過的項目。
body.en:
When opening a worktree (a Git feature that lets you keep parallel copies of the same project) with `claude --worktree`, slow setup now shows progress. The screen no longer stays blank while you wait.

Closing the worktree exit confirmation dialog no longer counts a newly created folder as one uncommitted file.

Some worktree sessions now skip certain plugin settings, and the screen clearly lists what was skipped.

items.original:
Fixed `claude --worktree` showing nothing while a slow worktree is set up
Fixed the worktree exit dialog counting a new folder as one uncommitted file
Changed some worktree sessions to skip some plugin settings; a notice names what was skipped

title.zh-TW: Worktree 子代理分支安全與清理限制
title.en: Worktree subagent branch safety and cleanup limits

body.zh-TW:
被隔離在 worktree 裡的子代理，現在在任何儲存庫都禁止透過 Bash 執行可能改寫共用分支的 git 指令；一般工作階段不受影響。

只要 worktree 裡還有背景子代理或殼層指令可能正在執行，`ExitWorktree` 就會拒絕移除該 worktree，除非 Claude 主動傳入 `discard_changes`。

建立 worktree、使用 `/teleport` 或 IDE 檢出時，現在會用更嚴格的 `PATH` 執行 git，自訂的 git 過濾器或輔助程式可能需要填寫完整路徑。⟦分房獨立寫草稿時，不准直接改掉大家共用的總目錄，裡面還有人在工作時退房也不會直接拆屋清空。⟧
body.en:
Subagents isolated in a worktree are now blocked from running git commands in Bash that could rewrite shared branches in any repository; regular sessions are unaffected.

As long as a background subagent or shell command might still be running in a worktree, `ExitWorktree` refuses to remove it unless Claude explicitly passes `discard_changes`.

Creating a worktree, using `/teleport`, or running IDE checkouts now invokes git with a stricter `PATH`, so custom git filters or helpers may need their full path. ⟦Writers drafting in separate rooms are not allowed to alter everyone's shared master index directly, and checking out while someone is still inside will not tear down and clear the room.⟧

items.original:
Changed subagents isolated in a worktree to refuse, in any repository, some git commands in Bash that can rewrite branches shared with your checkout; sessions are not affected
Changed `ExitWorktree` to refuse removing a worktree while a background subagent or shell command may still be running in it, unless Claude passes `discard_changes`
Changed worktree creation, `/teleport` and IDE checkouts to run git with a stricter `PATH`; a git filter or helper may need its full path

title.zh-TW: 背景工作階段的閘道保留與行程誤殺修復
title.en: Fixes for background session gateway retention and process mis-kills

body.zh-TW:
你在終端機匯出的 LLM 閘道，過去在背景執行遇到當機、從別的資料夾重開，或背景服務缺少它時會遺失；現在會先在送出任何模型請求前停下來，不會錯連。

背景服務清查程序時，若列表上的程序編號剛好被其他使用者的程序重複使用（例如你的 SSH 登入），過去竟會誤殺你自己的程序，現在已經修好。

當你開啟、停止或移除背景工作階段所接續的那個舊工作階段時，背景工作階段不會再一起被殺掉並弄丟請求。非互動執行或背景代理若權限檢查出錯，訊息也會點出原因。
body.en:
An LLM gateway exported in your terminal previously got lost in background runs after a crash, after reopening from another folder, or when the background service lacked it; sessions now stop before sending any model request instead of connecting to the wrong place.

Fixed an issue where the background service's process cleanup could mistakenly kill your own process (such as your SSH login) if a process ID on its list had been reused by another user's process.

Opening, stopping, or removing the older session that a background session resumed no longer kills the background session and loses its request. If a permission check errors out in non-interactive runs or background agents, the message now names the cause.

items.original:
Fixed background sessions losing the LLM gateway your shell exported after a crash, after a reopen from another folder, or when the background service lacks it: they now stop before any model request
Fixed the background service ending your own processes, such as an SSH login, when a process number on its list had been reused by another user's process
Fixed a background session being killed and its request lost when you opened, stopped or removed the older session whose conversation it had resumed
Improved the message in non-interactive runs and background agents when a permission check fails with an error, so it names the cause

title.zh-TW: 背景執行參數與 --bare 金鑰限制
title.en: Background flags and --bare key restrictions

body.zh-TW:
`--bare` 工作階段若用未經核准的 API 金鑰，多數環境現在會拒絕把它移到背景。若跑 `claude --bare --bg` 而背景服務沒有那把金鑰，也會直接報錯退出。

由於 `--bg` 與 `--worktree --tmux` 從來不會讀取初始化請求，現在只要同時帶上 `--await-initialize` 就會直接拒絕啟動，不再漏掉欄位硬跑。⟦寄件時若選了無人領取的自助櫃，卻還硬勾「當面簽收」，現在櫃檯會直接提醒不合理並退回，不再漏掉資料硬寄。⟧
body.en:
If a `--bare` session uses an unapproved API key, most setups now refuse moving it to the background. Running `claude --bare --bg` when the background service lacks that key also exits with an error.

Because `--bg` and `--worktree --tmux` never read the initialize request, passing `--await-initialize` alongside them is now refused at startup instead of running with missing fields. ⟦Sending a parcel to an unmanned pickup locker while still checking "sign in person" now makes the counter flag the contradiction and turn it away, rather than shipping it out with missing details.⟧

items.original:
Changed `--bare` sessions on an unapproved API key: moving one to the background is now refused in most setups, and `claude --bare --bg` exits with an error if the background service lacks the key
Changed `--await-initialize` to be refused with `--bg` or `--worktree --tmux`, which never read the initialize request, instead of starting without the fields it carries

title.zh-TW: 子代理回報對象、工具計數與多代理效能改善
title.en: Subagent reporting targets, tool counts, and multi-agent performance

body.zh-TW:
終端機主對話在等一個曾被其他子代理傳訊聯絡的背景子代理時，不再傻傻乾等，現在會得知它究竟向誰回報。

在離開對話連按兩次 `Ctrl+C` 或介面當掉結束工作階段時，背景代理不會再誤以為是你拒絕了它的工具呼叫。

在 auto mode 統計子代理工具次數時，不再把交最終報告的那一通算進去。工作流程恢復若遇到失敗，也會告訴 Claude 重用了幾筆結果與在哪停下。

同時跑超過 20 個子代理時，未開啟紀錄的背景代理改為每 5 秒更新一次 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計數，降低 CPU 負擔。
body.en:
When the main terminal conversation is waiting on a background subagent that another subagent messaged, it no longer waits blindly and is now told which agent the subagent reports to.

When a session ends after pressing `Ctrl+C` twice at the exit dialog or after an interface crash, background agents are no longer told you refused their tool call.

Subagent tool counts in auto mode no longer include the call that delivers the final report. When workflow resume hits a failure, it also tells Claude how many results were reused and where reuse stopped.

When more than 20 subagents run at once, background agents without an open transcript now update their token (the text unit AI processes and bills by) counts every 5 seconds to reduce CPU load.

items.original:
Fixed the main conversation of a terminal session waiting in silence for a background subagent that another subagent had messaged: it's now told which agent the subagent reports to
Fixed background agents being told you refused their tool call when a session ended by Ctrl+C twice at the exit dialog, or after an interface crash
Fixed subagent tool counts in auto mode including the call that delivers the agent's final report
Fixed workflow resume telling Claude every finished agent would be reused after a call failed; Claude is now told how many results were reused and where reuse stopped
Improved CPU use when more than 20 subagents are running: token counts of background agents whose transcript isn't open now update every 5 seconds

title.zh-TW: 輸入框下的代理與背景指令狀態列修復
title.en: Agent and background command status row fixes under the prompt

body.zh-TW:
代理明明已經講完一輪，輸入框下方那列卻還一直顯示忙碌。現在會寫明它在等什麼，`/tasks` 也會標出每個背景指令背後的子代理名稱。

已停止或失敗的代理不會再看起來像還在跑，平行執行時也不會誤標為「Done」，停掉的代理最後一道指令也不會繼續顯示「Running…」。

展開的背景代理重試請求時，不會再只轉普通圈圈。單輪啟動三個以上代理時，「background agents launched」不會只算到兩個；先前的「done」列也不再行行都顯示還有背景殼層在跑。
body.en:
When an agent finished its turn, the row under the prompt still showed it as busy. Now it states what it is waiting on, and `/tasks` names the subagent behind each background command.

Stopped or failed agents no longer look like they are still running or show "Done" when run in parallel, and a stopped agent's last command no longer stays on "Running…".
