title.zh-TW: 沙盒 Bash 預設改走一般權限流程
title.en: Sandboxed Bash now follows normal permissions by default

body.zh-TW:
平常在沙盒（隔離執行環境）裡直接跑 Bash 指令，現在不會再自動放行，而是照平時的權限規則來決定。

如果想維持不跳出詢問直接執行，請在設定檔加入下面這段設定。

```json
{"sandbox": {"autoAllowBashIfSandboxed": true}}
```

如果你是用管理員統一控管的設定來開啟沙盒，也必須在優先順序最高的那份管理設定來源加上同一組設定。這樣指令才會繼續免詢問執行。⟦跟進圖書館的獨立閱覽室一樣，以前進門就免登記借閱，現在改按一般借閱規則決定是否要登記；想維持免登記借閱，得另外開通權限。⟧
body.en:
Running Bash commands directly inside a sandbox (an isolated execution environment) no longer bypasses prompts automatically and now follows your normal permission rules.

To keep running them without prompts, add this configuration to your settings file.

```json
{"sandbox": {"autoAllowBashIfSandboxed": true}}
```

If you enable the sandbox through administrator-managed settings, you must also add the same setting in your highest-ranking managed source. That way, commands will continue running without prompts. ⟦Like entering a library's private reading room, borrowing used to skip sign-out upon entry, whereas normal borrowing rules now decide whether you need to sign; to keep skipping sign-out, you must enable that permission separately.⟧

items.original:
Changed sandboxed Bash commands to follow the normal permission flow by default; set `sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true` to keep running them without prompts
Changed managed settings that turn the sandbox on: to keep commands running without prompts, set `sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true` in your highest-ranking managed source

title.zh-TW: 沙盒加強保護外加目錄與更新資料夾
title.en: Sandbox strengthens protection for added directories and updater folder

body.zh-TW:
在沙盒裡執行的指令，寫入限制現在變得更嚴格。除了原本的啟動資料夾，你額外加入的目錄裡，`.claude` 底下的設定、技能、代理、指令與 hooks（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在也一律禁止被沙盒改寫。

當沙盒裡的 `git checkout`、`git stash` 或附帶自動暫存的 pull 沒辦法更新 `.claude` 等受保護檔案時，Claude 現在會收到一則提示說明原因。

某些情況下沙盒指令曾能寫入原生更新程式的下載資料夾，這個漏洞已經修好。

Bash 沙盒過去沒能完整保護 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）的設定與 hooks。連同連結 worktree 共用的 `.git` 資料夾，這兩項防護缺口現在也已經補上。
body.en:
Write restrictions for commands running inside the sandbox are now stricter. In addition to the launch folder, `.claude` settings, skills, agents, commands, and hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) in directories you add are now all blocked from being modified by the sandbox.

When a sandboxed `git checkout`, `git stash`, or pull with autostash cannot update protected files such as those in `.claude`, Claude now receives a note explaining why.

In some cases, sandboxed commands could previously write to the native updater's download folder, and this bug has now been fixed.

The Bash sandbox previously failed to fully protect the settings and hooks of a worktree (a Git feature for opening multiple parallel copies of the same project). Along with the shared `.git` folder of a linked worktree, both protection gaps have now been closed.

items.original:
Added a note for Claude when a sandboxed `git checkout`, `git stash` or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in `.claude`
Fixed sandboxed commands being able to write to the native updater's download folder in some cases
Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox did not fully protect a worktree's settings and hooks
Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox did not fully protect a linked worktree's shared git folder
Changed the sandbox to refuse sandboxed writes to `.claude` settings, skills, agents, commands and hooks in added directories, as it does in the launch folder

title.zh-TW: Claude Code 自用的輔助程式不再帶入登入金鑰
title.en: Claude Code's own helper programs no longer carry sign-in keys

body.zh-TW:
沙盒為了自身運作而啟動的程式，例如網路橋接工具，執行環境裡不再帶有 Claude Code 的登入 token（授權令牌）與 API 金鑰。

檔案搜尋工具 ripgrep、本機 Git 指令以及沙盒執行期的輔助程式，啟動時也不會再帶著雙向驗證憑證的 mTLS 金鑰密碼。⟦如同去沖印店洗照片，以前整本相簿連同底片盒都留給店員，現在只把要洗的那幾張檔案傳過去。⟧
body.en:
Programs that the sandbox starts for its own operation, such as its network bridge, no longer have Claude Code's sign-in tokens (authorization credentials) and API keys in their execution environment.

The file search tool ripgrep, local Git commands, and the sandbox runtime's helper programs also no longer launch with the mTLS client key's passphrase for mutual authentication certificates. ⟦Picture dropping off photos at a print shop: you used to leave the whole album and film canister with the clerk, whereas now you only send over the specific files to print.⟧

items.original:
Changed the programs that Claude Code's sandbox starts for its own use, such as its network bridge, to run without Claude Code's sign-in tokens and API keys in their environment
Changed ripgrep, local git commands and the sandbox runtime's own helper programs to run without the mTLS client key's passphrase in their environment

title.zh-TW: 修正 Linux 沙盒在允許讀取目錄下建檔失敗
title.en: Fix Linux sandbox file creation failure under allowed-read folders

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 環境裡，工作目錄可能位於 `denyRead` 限制內的 `allowRead` 資料夾底下。這種情況過去執行沙盒 Bash 指令會中斷，跳出 `bwrap: Can't create file` 錯誤訊息。例如透過符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）存取家目錄，就可能遇到上述目錄關係。現在這個問題已經修好。
body.en: On Linux, the working directory may sit under an `allowRead` folder inside a `denyRead` restriction. Previously, running sandboxed Bash commands in this situation would fail with a `bwrap: Can't create file` error message. For example, accessing your home directory through a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) could trigger this directory layout. This issue is now fixed.

items.original: Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `bwrap: Can't create file` when the working directory was below an `allowRead` folder inside a `denyRead`, such as under a symlinked home directory

title.zh-TW: 在非專案的外部儲存庫跑唯讀 Git 改先詢問
title.en: Read-only Git in untrusted external repositories now asks first

body.zh-TW:
Claude 想在目前專案以外、而且你還沒信任過的 Git 儲存庫裡執行唯讀 Git 指令，現在會先跳出確認才執行。

如果想讓這類跨儲存庫的唯讀查詢不用每次確認，啟動時必須用 `--add-dir` 參數明確指定該路徑。只寫在設定檔的 `additionalDirectories` 裡並不會自動免問。⟦像在機場免稅店試用展示品，以前只要不帶走就能直接試噴，現在跨進未登記的專櫃前，店員會先問過你，除非你早有領取試用券。⟧
body.en:
When Claude tries to run read-only Git commands in a Git repository outside the current project that you have not trusted yet, it now prompts for confirmation before running.

To run these cross-repository read-only queries without confirming every time, you must explicitly pass the path with `--add-dir` at startup. Listing it only in the `additionalDirectories` setting does not skip the prompt automatically. ⟦Think of sampling testers at an airport duty-free shop: before, you could spray freely as long as you didn't take anything, whereas now a clerk asks before you step into an unregistered counter unless you already claimed a sample pass.⟧

items.original: Changed read-only git commands to ask first in a repository that isn't the project's or one you trusted; name it with `--add-dir`, not the `additionalDirectories` setting, to run them without prompts

title.zh-TW: 排程任務與永久允許的權限判斷變嚴謹
title.en: Stricter permission checks for scheduled tasks and permanent allows

body.zh-TW:
排程任務與 `/loop` 指令在執行前，如果遇到本身宣告了 `allowed-tools` 或 hooks 的技能，現在會先停下來詢問你。想讓這類技能在無人值守時自動跑，要把對應的 `Skill(name)` 加進設定檔的允許清單。

```json
{"permissions": {"allow": ["Skill(name)"]}}
```

在桌面版、IDE 與 SDK 宿主環境裡，「Always allow」永遠允許選項也調整了出現條件。只有當存下來的單一規則真的能讓該指令下次直接放行時，畫面才會提供這個選項，因此過去依賴這類規則的排程任務現在可能會停下來等你確認。⟦好比辦健身房的自動續約，以前櫃檯只要有紀錄就會直接扣款開通，現在合約條款有變動或沒簽齊就會先暫停，等你親自到場確認後才繼續。⟧
body.en:
Before running scheduled tasks or the `/loop` command, Claude now pauses to ask you if a skill declares `allowed-tools` or hooks. To let such skills run unattended, add the corresponding `Skill(name)` entry to the allow list in your settings file.

```json
{"permissions": {"allow": ["Skill(name)"]}}
```

In Desktop, IDE, and SDK hosts, the "Always allow" option has also tightened when it appears. The UI now offers this option only when saving that single rule will actually allow the command again next time, so scheduled tasks that previously relied on such rules may now pause for your confirmation. ⟦A gym's auto-renewal desk used to charge and activate your pass whenever a record was on file, but now it pauses if contract terms changed or signatures are missing until you confirm in person.⟧

items.original:
Changed scheduled tasks and `/loop` to ask before running a skill that declares `allowed-tools` or hooks; add `Skill(name)` to `permissions.allow` to run it unattended
Changed "Always allow" in Desktop, IDE and SDK hosts: a rule alone is offered only when saving it would allow that command again, so a scheduled task that relied on one can now wait for you

title.zh-TW: 修正 Bash 權限規則漏判與錯執行程式
title.en: Fix missed Bash permission rules and wrong program execution

body.zh-TW:
先前設定好的 Bash 拒絕與詢問規則，遇到特定指令曾發生沒有套用的情況，這個問題已經修好。

部分組合在一起的複合 Bash 指令過去會繞過權限檢查直接執行，現在這類指令都會先跳出詢問視窗等你確認。

過去還有一種情況會讓 Bash 允許規則實際執行到與規則名稱不同的程式，這個漏洞也已經補上。
body.en:
Fixed an issue where previously configured Bash deny and ask rules failed to apply to certain commands.

Some compound Bash commands used to bypass permission checks and run directly, and these commands now show a confirmation prompt first.

Also closed a gap where a Bash allow rule could actually execute a different program than the one named in the rule.

items.original:
Fixed some deny and ask rules not applying to certain Bash commands
Fixed a gap in Bash permission checks where some compound commands could run without asking; these now ask for permission
Fixed a case where a Bash allow rule could run a different program than the one it names

title.zh-TW: 修正權限規則在切換目錄與重啟後的漏判
title.en: Fix missed permission rules after changing directories or restarting

body.zh-TW:
像是 `Read(./.env)` 這類使用相對路徑的拒絕與詢問權限規則，過去只要執行過 `cd` 切換目錄就不再覆蓋原本專案。這個問題已經修好，現在這些規則在額外加入的目錄裡也會生效。

以 `mcp__plugin_*_` 開頭的規則會比對外掛的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器或工具。過去名稱大小寫不同就會漏判，這個問題已經修好。

在自託管執行器與 `claude remote-control` 工作階段中，有時權限核准會在 Claude Code 重啟後才送達。過去這類情況不會套用先前設定的拒絕規則，這個漏洞現在也已經修好。
body.en:
Relative deny and ask permission rules such as `Read(./.env)` previously stopped covering the original project after running `cd` to switch directories. This issue is fixed, and these rules now also apply in added directories.

Rules starting with `mcp__plugin_*_` match a plugin's MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server or tool. Previously, differing letter case in the name would cause a miss, and this issue is now fixed.

In self-hosted runners and `claude remote-control` sessions, a permission approval can sometimes arrive after Claude Code restarts. Previously, existing deny rules were not applied in that situation, and this gap is now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed relative deny and ask permission rules (e.g. `Read(./.env)`) no longer covering the project after a `cd`; they now also apply in added directories
Fixed deny and ask permission rules starting with `mcp__plugin_*_` missing a plugin's MCP server or tool spelled in another letter case
Fixed deny rules not being applied to a permission approval that arrives after Claude Code restarts, in self-hosted runner and `claude remote-control` sessions

title.zh-TW: 專案本機權限設定檔改為嚴格驗證信任
title.en: Strict trust verification for project-local permission settings

body.zh-TW:
把儲存庫裡已提交的 `.claude/settings.local.json` 誤當成個人設定檔的漏洞已經修好。過去從儲存庫某些子資料夾啟動 Claude Code 時，這份已進版控的檔案曾會被當作使用者自己的設定套用。

當你透過 `-p` 參數或 SDK，在掛載進容器的 worktree 或子模組裡執行任務時，權限檢查變得更嚴謹。現在必須先確認信任該資料夾，`.claude/settings.local.json` 裡的允許規則才會生效。⟦外包人員帶來的門禁卡，以前進到某些樓層就直接放行，現在得先由屋主確認信任這張卡，門禁才會真正開通。⟧
body.en:
Fixed a bug where a committed `.claude/settings.local.json` file in a repository was mistakenly treated as a personal settings file. Previously, when starting Claude Code from certain subfolders of a repository, this version-controlled file could be applied as the user's own settings.

Permission checks are now stricter when running tasks via the `-p` flag or the SDK inside a worktree or submodule mounted into a container. The folder must now be trusted first before allow rules in `.claude/settings.local.json` take effect. ⟦An access badge brought by a contractor used to grant access to certain floors right away, but now the owner must first confirm they trust the badge before access actually opens.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a case where a committed `.claude/settings.local.json` could be treated as the user's own when Claude Code was started in certain subfolders of a repository
Changed `-p` and SDK runs in a worktree or submodule mounted into a container to apply `.claude/settings.local.json` allow rules only once the folder is trusted

title.zh-TW: 修正斜線指令授權外洩給背景代理
title.en: Fix slash command tool grants leaking to background agents

body.zh-TW: 當某個指令透過 `allowed-tools` 暫時放行特定工具時，這份臨時權限過去會一路延續到同一回合或之後才被喚醒的代理。現在這個問題已經修好，背景代理不會再繼承這項額外授權。
body.en: When a slash command temporarily allows specific tools through `allowed-tools`, those temporary permissions previously carried over to agents woken during or after that turn. This issue is now fixed, and background agents no longer inherit that extra grant.

items.original: Fixed a slash command's `allowed-tools` grants applying to background agents woken during or after its turn

title.zh-TW: 修正核准子代理計畫後權限模式倒退
title.en: Fix permission mode reverting after approving a subagent's plan

body.zh-TW: 當你點頭讓子代理執行它擬好的步驟時，目前的工作階段過去偶爾會退回更早之前的設定。這個問題已經修好，現在工作階段會維持應有的權限模式。
body.en: When you approve a subagent to carry out its planned steps, the current session could occasionally revert to an earlier setting. That issue is now fixed, so the session keeps the permission mode it should have.

items.original: Fixed a session sometimes going back to an earlier permission mode after a subagent's plan was approved

title.zh-TW: 調整 Artifact 權限詢問與對外內容把關
title.en: Adjust Artifact permission prompts and external content safeguards

body.zh-TW:
讀取你自己建立的 Artifact 或裡面的資料，Claude 過去還會跳出權限詢問，現在已經不用再確認。

雲端工作階段裡針對 Artifact 工具設定的拒絕、詢問規則與 hooks，過去偶爾沒有套用的問題也已經修好。

針對組織外部人員看得到的 Artifact，權限把關現在更嚴密。即使先前設了允許規則或曾核准上傳，子代理想修改這類外部 Artifact 或上傳檔案前都必須先詢問你。就算你對 Artifact 勾過「不要再問」，發佈外部頁面時也不會略過確認。

在自動模式下，過去只會審核對外 Artifact 的第一次修改；現在每次放行都只涵蓋當下那一次更動，後續修改會重新判斷。
body.en:
Claude no longer asks for permission before reading an Artifact you created or the data inside it.

Fixed an issue where deny and ask permission rules and hooks configured for the Artifact tool occasionally failed to apply in cloud sessions.

Permission checks are now stricter for Artifacts visible to people outside your organization. Even if an allow rule is set or uploads were approved earlier, a subagent must ask you first before modifying such an external Artifact or uploading files to it. Even if you selected "don't ask again" for Artifact, publishing an external page will not skip confirmation.

In auto mode, only the first change to an external Artifact used to be reviewed; now each approval covers only that single change, and subsequent edits are evaluated again.

items.original:
Fixed Claude asking for permission before reading your own artifact or its data
Fixed deny and ask permission rules and hooks for the Artifact tool not applying in some cloud sessions
Fixed some subagents changing an artifact that people outside your organization can see, or uploading files to it, without asking first when an allow rule is set or uploads were approved earlier
Fixed some artifact publishes skipping the confirmation for pages that people outside your organization can see when "don't ask again" had been chosen for Artifact
Fixed auto mode judging only the first change to an artifact that people outside your organization can see; its yes now covers that change alone

title.zh-TW: 修正 zstd 壓縮回應解碼的安全漏洞
title.en: Fix security issue when decoding zstd-compressed responses

body.zh-TW: Claude Code 解碼採用 zstd 壓縮格式的回應內容，過去存在一項安全問題。這個漏洞已經修好，更新到這個版本後就能排除這項風險。
body.en: Claude Code previously had a security issue when decoding zstd-compressed responses. That vulnerability is now fixed, and updating to this version removes the risk.

items.original: Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded

title.zh-TW: 隔離 worktree 禁用部分 Git 指令與捷徑掛鉤
title.en: Block select Git commands and symlink hooks in isolated worktrees

body.zh-TW:
在隔離的 worktree 工作階段或代理裡，現在禁止執行幾項 Git 指令。這包括 `git bisect run`、`git maintenance register|start` 與 `scalar` 的初始設定，被擋下時畫面還會告訴你哪些指令仍能使用。

呼叫 `EnterWorktree` 時，如果 `WorktreeCreate` 掛鉤提供的路徑經過專案裡的符號連結，它就會直接拒絕。請讓該掛鉤改印出真實路徑。⟦分租一間工作室時，房東只准你用分給自己的工作桌，列在禁用清單上的工具或繞道捷徑都不放行。⟧
body.en:
Several Git commands are now blocked inside an isolated worktree session or agent. This includes `git bisect run`, `git maintenance register|start`, and `scalar`'s setup commands, and when blocked, the output tells you which commands still work.

When calling `EnterWorktree`, if the path provided by a `WorktreeCreate` hook passes through a symlink inside the project, it is rejected. Have the hook print the real path instead. ⟦When you sublet a studio, the landlord only lets you use your assigned workbench—tools on the banned list and shortcut detours are off-limits.⟧

items.original:
Changed worktree isolation: an isolated worktree session or agent is now refused `git bisect run`, `git maintenance register|start` and `scalar`'s set-up commands, and is told what still works
Changed EnterWorktree to refuse a `WorktreeCreate` hook path that goes through a symlink inside the project; have the hook print the real path

title.zh-TW: 修正多種 Git 檢出與稀疏複製的異常
title.en: Fix issues across Git checkouts and sparse clones

body.zh-TW:
如果你在純儲存庫 worktree、`--separate-git-dir` 或 Android `repo` 檢出環境下工作，以前可能會卡關。`/security-review` 與技能內嵌的 Git 指令過去會報錯停住，這個問題現在已經修好。

在新家目錄首次以 `--worktree` 啟動時，Claude Code 過去會跳過 `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` 裡的掛鉤。現在外掛帶的 `WorktreeCreate` 掛鉤在第一次執行就能正常觸發。

在像 2.34 這類較舊的 Git 版本上，設定 `worktree.sparsePaths` 過去會漏掉儲存庫根目錄的檔案。外掛與市集的稀疏複製也有同樣問題，現在都已經修好。
body.en:
If you work in bare-repository worktrees, `--separate-git-dir` checkouts, or Android `repo` checkouts, you might have run into errors before. `/security-review` and inline Git commands in skills used to stop with an error, and that issue is now fixed.

On the first run with `--worktree` in a new home directory, Claude Code previously skipped hooks in `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR`. Now `WorktreeCreate` hooks from plugins trigger normally on that first run.

On older Git versions such as 2.34, setting `worktree.sparsePaths` previously left out files in the repository root. The same issue affected sparse clones for plugins and marketplaces, and both are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `/security-review` and skills' inline git commands stopping with an error in worktrees of bare repositories, `--separate-git-dir` checkouts and Android `repo` checkouts
Fixed `--worktree` skipping a `WorktreeCreate` hook from a plugin in `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` on the first run in a new home directory
Fixed `worktree.sparsePaths` and sparse plugin and marketplace clones leaving out the repository's root files on older git versions, such as 2.34

title.zh-TW: 修正 /teleport 在特殊 Git 狀態的暫存判斷
title.en: Fix /teleport stash handling in unusual Git states

body.zh-TW: 在部分不尋常的 Git 狀態下執行 `/teleport`，過去處理暫存變動的判斷容易出錯。這個問題已經修好，現在遇到這類狀況會停下來並告訴你接下來該怎麼處理。
body.en: Running `/teleport` in certain unusual Git states previously made the wrong choice when handling stashed changes. That issue is now fixed, so it stops and tells you what to do next.

items.original: Fixed `/teleport`'s stash choice in some unusual git states: it now stops and says what to do

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集與安裝提示明確警告可執行程式碼
title.en: Warn clearly about code execution in plugin marketplace and install prompts

body.zh-TW: 看到一個好用的外掛準備點安裝嗎？無論是在新增外掛市集的確認畫面、推薦外掛的提示，還是外掛安裝警告上，現在都會明確寫出外掛可以在你的電腦上執行程式碼，而且能存取你的檔案與終端機殼層。⟦拿下載瀏覽器擴充功能來說，以前只按確定，現在店家會先亮出權限清單，讓你看清楚它看得到哪些資料再決定要不要裝。⟧
body.en: About to install a promising plugin? Across the add-marketplace confirmation screen, plugin recommendation prompts, and the plugin install warning, the text now explicitly states that plugins can run code on your computer and access your files and shell. ⟦Downloading a browser extension used to mean just clicking OK, but now the store shows the permission list upfront so you can see what data it can access before deciding whether to install it.⟧

items.original: Improved the add-marketplace confirmations, plugin recommendation prompts and plugin install warning to say that plugins can run code on your computer, with access to your files and shell

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集支援特定 commit 鎖定與代理下載
title.en: Support specific commit pinning and proxy downloads for plugin marketplaces

body.zh-TW:
私人外掛市集如果跳出 `HTTPS authentication failed` 錯誤，現在會說明 Git 的終端機互動提示與密碼輸入程式已被停用。較新版本的 Git 現在也會正常顯示這則訊息。

市集的 `ref` 欄位現在支援填入分支或標籤上任一筆提交的完整 commit ID；不過這個版本之前的舊用戶端無法複製這種鎖定方式，遇到時該市集會無法載入。

當環境只設定了 `ALL_PROXY` 作為代理時，外掛市集與外掛下載會改走 CONNECT 通道；如果代理伺服器拒絕 CONNECT 連線，下載就會直接失敗。
body.en:
When a private plugin marketplace shows an `HTTPS authentication failed` error, it now explains that Git's terminal prompts and askpass programs are disabled. Newer versions of Git now display this message properly as well.

The marketplace `ref` field now accepts the full commit ID of any commit on a branch or tag; however, older clients before this version cannot clone this kind of pin, so a marketplace pinned this way fails to load there.

When `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy configured in the environment, plugin marketplace and plugin downloads now use a CONNECT tunnel; if the proxy server refuses CONNECT connections, the download fails.

items.original:
Improved the `HTTPS authentication failed` message for private plugin marketplaces: it now says git's terminal prompts and askpass programs are disabled, and it also appears with newer git versions
Changed marketplace `ref` to accept the full ID of any commit on a branch or tag; clients before this version can't clone such a pin, so a marketplace pinned this way stops loading there
Changed plugin marketplace and plugin downloads to use a CONNECT tunnel when `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy set; a proxy that refuses CONNECT now fails them

title.zh-TW: 調整外掛套件解壓與安全載入規則
title.en: Adjust plugin bundle unpacking and safe loading rules

body.zh-TW:
外掛的 `.mcpb` 與 `.dxt` MCP 套件包，不再解壓到外掛自己目錄底下的 `.mcpb-cache`，而是改放在外掛總目錄裡，讓唯讀的外掛資料夾也能載入。若是透過網址抓下來的套件，更新後會再重新下載一次。

載入外掛時會自動跳過資料夾內部分不安全的路徑與連結，執行 `claude plugin validate` 時也會把這些項目回報出來。

用 `--plugin-dir` 掛載的外掛，其內部的 `.claude/skills` 巢狀技能資料夾，現在不會從上層目錄啟動的工作階段載入。要使用這些技能時，請直接在外掛資料夾內啟動 Claude Code。
body.en:
Plugin `.mcpb` and `.dxt` MCP bundles no longer unpack into `.mcpb-cache` inside the plugin's own folder, and are placed under the plugins directory instead so read-only plugin folders can still load. Bundles fetched by URL will download again once after updating.

When loading a plugin, certain unsafe paths and links inside its folder are automatically skipped, and running `claude plugin validate` reports them as well.

For plugins loaded with `--plugin-dir`, nested `.claude/skills` folders inside them no longer load from sessions started in a parent directory. To use those skills, start Claude Code directly inside the plugin folder.

items.original:
Changed plugin MCP bundles (`.mcpb`, `.dxt`) to unpack under the plugins directory, not `.mcpb-cache` in the plugin's folder, so read-only plugin folders load; one fetched by URL downloads again once
Changed plugin loading to skip, and `claude plugin validate` to report, some unsafe paths and links in a plugin's folder
Changed nested skill loading: `.claude/skills` folders in `--plugin-dir` plugins no longer load from a session started above them; start Claude Code in the plugin folder instead

title.zh-TW: 修正 claude plugin eval 空輸出路徑的錯誤
title.en: Fix claude plugin eval error on empty output path

body.zh-TW: 執行 `claude plugin eval --output-dir ''` 且輸出路徑留空，過去會誤把報告直接寫進目前的工作資料夾。這個問題已經修好，現在遇到空路徑參數會直接報錯結束。
body.en: Running `claude plugin eval --output-dir ''` with an empty output path previously wrote the report directly into the current working folder by mistake. That issue is now fixed, and an empty path argument now exits with an error.

items.original: Fixed `claude plugin eval --output-dir ''` writing the report into the current folder; it now exits with an error

title.zh-TW: 組織管理設定的遠端外掛與自訂鎖定規則更新
title.en: Updates to managed remote plugins and customization locks

body.zh-TW:
管理設定已宣告並啟用的遠端市集，其中列在 `prependPlugins` 或 `appendPlugins` 的外掛，現在會被認定為組織自己的外掛。原本的 `pluginDigests` 設定已經棄用，設定了也會被忽略。

組織用來鎖定代理與技能只能來自外掛的 `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` 規定，過去對於已經啟動中的工作階段不會立即生效。這個問題已經修好，現在跑一半的工作階段同樣會受這道鎖定限制。⟦公司更新了門禁白名單與規範，不僅認列特約廠商的工具，連已經刷卡進場正在辦公的員工也會立刻套用新規定。⟧
body.en:
Plugins from a remote marketplace declared and enabled in managed settings, when listed under `prependPlugins` or `appendPlugins`, are now treated as the organization's own plugins. The `pluginDigests` setting is deprecated and ignored even if configured.

The `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` rule, which organizations use to restrict agents and skills to plugins only, previously did not take effect immediately in sessions that were already running. This is now fixed, so sessions already in progress are subject to the same lock. ⟦A company updates its badge whitelist and rules so approved contractor tools are recognized, while employees who have already badged in and are working at their desks immediately fall under the new policy as well.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a managed `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` lock on agents and skills not taking effect in sessions that were already running
Changed plugins of a remote marketplace that managed settings declare, enable and list in `prependPlugins` or `appendPlugins` to count as the organization's; `pluginDigests` is deprecated and ignored

title.zh-TW: 改進內建資料視覺化技能的比例圖表建議
title.en: Improved part-to-whole advice in the bundled dataviz skill

body.zh-TW: 製作靜態圖表或呈現年齡區間這類具有自然順序的分組資料，你都能從內建的 dataviz 技能得到更貼切的整體與部分比例呈現建議。
body.en: When creating static charts or presenting grouped data with a natural order such as age bands, the bundled dataviz skill now gives more fitting advice on showing part-to-whole proportions.

items.original: Improved the bundled dataviz skill's part-to-whole advice for static images and for parts with a natural order, such as age bands

title.zh-TW: 修正 MCP 伺服器清單殘留與重連認證異常
title.en: Fixes for stale MCP server lists and reconnection auth issues

body.zh-TW:
在 Claude Desktop 或 SDK 工作階段裡，只要資料夾搬家或預熱啟動，連線清單就容易出錯。資料夾本身的 `.mcp.json` 與本機 MCP 伺服器過去會誤標或漏列，WebSocket 伺服器也連不上，這些問題已修好。

外掛在 MCP 伺服器連線時重載並移除它，`/mcp` 清單過去會留著舊項目，現在會清掉。

更新授權令牌若短暫遭拒，MCP 伺服器過去會卡在「needs authentication」並跳過 `mcp_tool` hooks，現已修好。

在 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）呼叫工具期間，若連線被替換，MCP 資訊徵詢請求過去會未經詢問就被取消，這個問題已經修好。

從 SDK 宿主發出的 MCP 工具呼叫，即使前一次已重連，過去有時仍會報錯「Not connected」，現已修好。
body.en:
In Claude Desktop or SDK sessions, connection lists could break whenever a folder moved or started pre-warmed. A folder's own `.mcp.json` and local MCP servers were previously mislabeled or omitted, and WebSocket servers failed to connect; these issues are now fixed.

When a plugin reloads and removes an MCP server while it is connecting, the `/mcp` list previously kept the old entry and now clears it.

If a token refresh was briefly refused, an MCP server previously stayed stuck in "needs authentication" and skipped `mcp_tool` hooks; this is now fixed.

During a tool call in headless mode (execution without a terminal window), MCP elicitation requests were previously cancelled without asking if the connection was replaced; this issue is now fixed.

MCP tool calls from an SDK host previously sometimes returned "Not connected" even after a prior call had reconnected; this is now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed Claude Desktop and SDK sessions listing a folder's own MCP servers (`.mcp.json`, local) as host-added or not at all, and not connecting WebSocket ones, after a folder move or pre-warmed start
Fixed `/mcp` still listing a plugin's MCP server after a plugin reload removed it while it was connecting
Fixed an MCP server staying "needs authentication", and its `mcp_tool` hooks being skipped, after a token refresh that was refused only for a moment
Fixed MCP elicitation requests being cancelled without asking in headless mode after a server's connection was replaced during a tool call
Fixed MCP tool calls from an SDK host answering "Not connected" after a tool call had reconnected the MCP server

title.zh-TW: 改善背景 MCP 任務提問延後與 /tasks 流程
title.en: Improved deferring background MCP task prompts and /tasks flow

body.zh-TW:
背景執行的 MCP 任務跳出問題，按 Esc 鍵現在改為「稍後回答」，不會傳任何內容給伺服器，問題會留在 `/tasks` 裡等你。當任務還在等你的回覆時，Claude 也會收到通知，並引導你去 `/tasks` 處理。

如果你正打字寫訊息到一半，背景 MCP 任務的問題現在不會突然蓋在輸入框上，而是等你送出或清空草稿才打開，期間等待動畫與回合碼錶會照常計時。

先前用 Esc 關閉或重新發問曾讓 MCP 任務卡死；現在頁尾會提示需要你輸入，進 `/tasks` 按 Enter 就能再叫出問題。

同一部伺服器的另一次呼叫斷線後再連回來時，背景 MCP 任務過去會停止更新進度，這個問題也已經修好。⟦診間掛號後先去旁邊填資料時，以前叫號機常直接蓋掉你手上那份表格，現在會等你寫完才繼續叫號並保留你的號碼。⟧
body.en:
Pressing Esc on a question from a background MCP task now sets it to "answer later", sending nothing to the server and keeping the question waiting in `/tasks`. Claude is also notified when a task is waiting for your reply and can point you to `/tasks`.

If you are in the middle of typing a message, a background MCP task's question no longer opens over your input box; it waits until you send or clear the draft, while the spinner and turn timer keep running.

Closing a question with Esc or asking it again previously left an MCP task stuck; the footer now indicates that your input is needed, and pressing Enter in `/tasks` brings the question back up.

Background MCP tasks previously stopped updating progress when another call to the same server lost its connection and a later call reconnected; this issue is also fixed. ⟦After checking in at a clinic and stepping aside to fill out paperwork, the queue screen used to cover the form in your hands, whereas now it waits until you finish writing before calling you and keeps your number.⟧

items.original:
Fixed an MCP task getting stuck after its question was closed with Esc or asked again: the footer now says it needs your input, and Enter in `/tasks` shows the question again
Fixed background MCP tasks that stopped updating after another call to the same server lost the connection, when a later call reconnects
Fixed a background MCP task's question opening over a message you were still typing; it now waits until you send or clear the draft, and the spinner and turn timer keep running
Improved MCP tasks: Claude is now told when a task is waiting for your answer, and can point you to `/tasks`
Changed Esc on a background MCP task's question to "answer later": nothing is sent to the server, and the question stays in `/tasks`

title.zh-TW: 調整 /login 隱私確認與修正登入失敗畫面
title.en: Updated /login privacy prompt and fixed sign-in failure states

body.zh-TW:
透過 `/login` 登入，如果要改動你的隱私設定，現在會先跳出詢問取得你的同意。

在 `/login` 點選「Sign in with your Console account」用主控台帳號登入，若在瀏覽器步驟剛結束就按 Esc 取消，過去會覆蓋掉原本的登入狀態。瀏覽器在登入失敗或取消時偶爾還顯示成功頁面的問題，現在也都已經修好。

用 `claude --desktop` 登入 Claude 帳號卻被擋下時，錯誤訊息現在會直接點名是哪一組 API 金鑰、服務提供者或設定卡住了登入。
body.en:
When signing in via `/login`, you are now asked for permission before your privacy settings are changed.

Choosing "Sign in with your Console account" in `/login` and pressing Esc right after the browser step previously overwrote your existing sign-in state. The issue where the browser occasionally showed the sign-in success page when sign-in failed or was canceled is also fixed.

When signing in to a Claude account with `claude --desktop` is blocked, the error message now names the specific API key, provider, or setting preventing sign-in.

items.original:
Fixed "Sign in with your Console account" in `/login` replacing your existing login when you pressed Esc right after the browser step
Fixed the browser showing the sign-in success page in some cases where sign-in failed or was canceled
Improved the `claude --desktop` sign-in error to name the API key, provider or setting that stops a Claude account sign-in from working
Changed `/login` to ask for permission to change your privacy settings

title.zh-TW: 加速主控台登入啟動並清理殘留鎖定檔
title.en: Faster Console sign-in startup and lock file cleanup

body.zh-TW:
當你用免金鑰的 Console 帳號或其他 Anthropic 設定檔開啟工具時，只要手上的授權令牌還沒過期，現在會直接讀取，不必再排隊等憑證鎖定解除。

先前執行 `claude auth status` 這類短指令後，主控台設定檔曾會留下一道鎖定，害下一個工作階段卡住約一分鐘，這個問題已經修好。

設定目錄裡過去會越積越多的 `.oauth_refresh.lock.owner.tmp.*` 暫存鎖定檔，現在也不會再殘留。
body.en:
When launching with a keyless Console account or another Anthropic profile, a token that has not expired is now read directly without waiting for the credentials lock.

Running short commands like `claude auth status` previously left a lock behind on a Console profile, causing the next session to hang for about a minute; this is now fixed.

Temporary `.oauth_refresh.lock.owner.tmp.*` lock files that previously piled up in the config directory are no longer left behind.

items.original:
Fixed leftover `.oauth_refresh.lock.owner.tmp.*` files piling up in the config directory
Fixed `claude auth status` and other short commands leaving a lock behind on a Console profile, which made the next session hang for about a minute
Improved startup with a keyless Console sign-in or other Anthropic profile login: a token that is still valid is read without waiting for the credentials lock

title.zh-TW: 修正無 HOME 環境變數時雲端憑證讀取失敗
title.en: Fixed cloud credential loading without a HOME variable

body.zh-TW: 未設定 `HOME` 環境變數啟動時，AWS 的 `credential_process` 輔助程式與 Google Cloud 預設憑證曾無法正常運作。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: AWS `credential_process` helpers and Google Cloud default credentials previously failed when starting without a `HOME` environment variable set. This issue is now fixed.

items.original: Fixed AWS `credential_process` helpers and Google Cloud default credentials failing when Claude Code is started without a `HOME` environment variable

title.zh-TW: 無快取下執行 claude -p 會先等帳號資料
title.en: claude -p waits for account data when uncached

body.zh-TW: 當你在全新、還沒存過登入紀錄的環境裡跑單次指令模式時，現在發送第一筆請求前會先等用戶資訊載入完成。這代表在沒有帳號快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）的情況下，執行 `claude -p` 的初次啟動可能會比以前晚幾秒。
body.en: When running single-prompt mode in a clean environment with no saved login record, it now waits for user data to finish loading before sending the first request. This means an initial `claude -p` run without an account cache can start a few seconds later than before.

items.original: Changed `claude -p` with no cached account data to wait for that data before its first request, so a first run in a clean environment can start a few seconds later

title.zh-TW: 修正 /fast 與 /model 誤報組織限制
title.en: Fixed false organization restrictions in /fast and /model

body.zh-TW:
使用免金鑰的 Console 主控台登入時，Claude Code 其實還沒問過伺服器。過去 `/fast` 卻會直接報錯「Fast mode has been disabled by your organization」。

遇到斷網等無法連線確認的狀況時，`/model` 過去也會誤稱組織限制了某個模型。這兩項未經確認就誤報限制的問題都已經修好。
body.en:
Under keyless Console sign-in, Claude Code had not actually checked with the server yet, yet `/fast` previously reported "Fast mode has been disabled by your organization".

When unable to verify over the network, such as when offline, `/model` also previously claimed that your organization restricted a model. Both issues of falsely reporting restrictions without checking are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `/fast` saying "Fast mode has been disabled by your organization" under the keyless Console sign-in, where Claude Code had not asked the server
Fixed `/model` saying that your organization restricts a model when Claude Code could not check that, for example with no network

title.zh-TW: 帳號 Email 身分檢查涵蓋腳本與連線
title.en: Account email check covers scripts and network calls

body.zh-TW: 指令執行的腳本、寫入檔案、抓取網頁與 MCP 呼叫，現在也都會受帳號 Email 檢查把關，不讓你的 Email 被當成用戶端身分送出。
body.en: Scripts run by commands, file writes, web fetches, and MCP calls are now also covered by the account email check, preventing your email from being sent as a client identity.

items.original: Improved the account email check: it now also refuses your email as a client's identity in scripts a command runs, file writes, web fetches and MCP calls

title.zh-TW: 修正 /feedback 與 /bug 上傳非本帳號紀錄
title.en: Fix /feedback and /bug uploading other accounts' sessions

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/feedback` 或 `/bug` 回報問題並附帶其他工作階段紀錄，過去可能夾帶到其他帳號的內容。這個問題已經修好，現在只會上傳目前登入帳號或同一組織所錄下的工作階段。
body.en: When using `/feedback` or `/bug` to report an issue with other session records attached, content from other accounts could previously be included. This issue is fixed, and now only sessions recorded by the currently signed-in account or the same organization are uploaded.

items.original: Fixed `/feedback` and `/bug` to upload other sessions only when they were recorded by the signed-in account or organization

title.zh-TW: 隔離背景工作階段帳務並擋下切換登入帳號
title.en: Isolate background session billing and block account switches

body.zh-TW:
用 claude.ai 帳號在背景啟動的工作階段，過去曾誤用到啟動背景服務那個殼層裡的 API 金鑰或令牌並產生計費，這個問題已經修好。

當工作階段在背景運作時，更多可能切換到另一個登入帳號的情況現在都會被拒絕，畫面還會告訴你哪種做法才行得通。若背景切換被拒後你在離開視窗再按一次 Enter，也不會誤把背景工作停掉。

背景工作階段若無法使用自己的 API 金鑰或令牌，提示訊息現在也不會再誤導你把金鑰寫進設定檔裡。⟦值夜班的同事接手專案時，以前可能誤刷前面早班留下的信用卡帳單，現在兩邊帳戶切得一清二楚，不會再混在一起扣款。⟧
body.en:
Background sessions started with a claude.ai account previously could mistakenly use and bill an API key or token from the shell that started the background service, and this issue is fixed.

While a session is running in the background, more cases that could switch to another signed-in account are now refused, and the screen tells you what works instead. If you press Enter again in the exit dialog after a background move is refused, it also no longer stops background work by mistake.

When a background session cannot use its own API key or token, the prompt message no longer misleads you into writing the key into the config file. ⟦Imagine a night-shift colleague taking over a project and accidentally charging the credit card left by the earlier shift—now the two accounts are clearly separated so charges never mix.⟧

items.original:
Fixed background sessions started on your claude.ai login using (and billing) an API key or token from the shell that started the background service
Fixed more cases of a session moving to another sign-in in the background; these moves are now refused, with a message saying what works
Fixed a second Enter in the exit dialog stopping background work after the move to the background was refused
Improved the messages shown when a background session can't use its session's API key or token: they no longer suggest adding the key to settings

title.zh-TW: claude remote-control 結束碼與斷線
title.en: claude remote-control exit codes and disconnect

body.zh-TW:
遠端控制工具 `claude remote-control` 調整了結束代碼，讓服務管理程式能自動幫你重啟。自行停止時會回傳狀態碼 4，單一工作階段仍回傳 0，無法註冊則回傳 69。

在 Remote Control 連線狀態下，如果目前連著的工作階段設有分享連結，或是無法確認是否有分享連結，執行 `/resume` 或 `/teleport` 時會先中斷連線。切換後想重連，再打一次 `/remote-control` 就好。⟦遠端遙控器跟主機配對時，發現門鎖換過或狀態不明會先主動斷線，重開失敗也會回傳明確訊號讓管家自動重啟。⟧
body.en:
The remote control tool `claude remote-control` has adjusted its exit codes so a service manager can automatically restart it for you. It returns status code 4 when stopping on its own, still returns 0 for a single session, and returns 69 when it fails to register.

While connected via Remote Control, if the currently connected session has a share link or whether it has one cannot be confirmed, running `/resume` or `/teleport` disconnects first. To reconnect after switching, just run `/remote-control` again. ⟦Just as a remote control pairing with a host disconnects first if the lock changed or its status is unclear, a failed restart also sends a clear signal so the caretaker can reboot it automatically.⟧

items.original:
Improved `claude remote-control`: it now exits with status 4 when it stops by itself (single-session runs still exit 0) and 69 when it can't register, so a service manager can start it again
Remote Control: Changed `/resume` and `/teleport` to disconnect first when the connected session has a share link, or when that can't be checked; run `/remote-control` to connect again

title.zh-TW: 雲端與遠端預算錯誤不再叫你找管理員調額
title.en: Cloud and remote budget errors drop admin raise prompt

body.zh-TW: 如果你在網頁或遠端連線的工作階段裡遇到花費上限與共用預算錯誤，畫面跳出的錯誤訊息現在會變得更精簡。過去提示裡那句叫你聯絡管理員調高上限的「ask your admin to raise it」，已經從雲端與 Remote Control 環境中移除。
body.en: If you hit spend limit or shared budget errors in web or remote sessions, the error message shown on screen is now shorter. The previous prompt line telling you to contact an admin to raise the limit, "ask your admin to raise it", has been removed from cloud and Remote Control environments.

items.original: Removed "ask your admin to raise it" from spend limit and shared budget errors in cloud sessions and under Remote Control

title.zh-TW: 調整雲端工作階段沙盒限制並修連接器錯誤
title.en: Adjust cloud sandbox limits and fix connector errors

body.zh-TW:
託管容器本身沒有指令沙盒，但這不會再擋住網頁版 Claude Code、雲端排程任務與 Cowork 雲端工作階段。就算設定了 `sandbox.failIfUnavailable`，這些雲端環境現在依然能順利啟動。

雲端工作階段裡，當外掛以不同網址列出原本正常的 Atlassian、Asana 或 Sentry 連接器時，Claude 過去會誤報連接失敗。外掛還在載入期間，連接器工具的授權詢問也曾被自動回覆，這兩個問題都已經修好。
body.en:
Hosted containers have no command sandbox, yet this no longer blocks Claude Code on the web, cloud scheduled tasks, or Cowork cloud sessions. Even when `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` is set, these cloud environments now start up smoothly.

In cloud sessions, when a plugin listed a working Atlassian, Asana, or Sentry connector under a different URL, Claude previously reported a connection failure by mistake. Approval prompts for connector tools were also answered automatically while plugins were still loading, and both issues are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed Claude saying a working Atlassian, Asana or Sentry connector had failed in cloud sessions when a plugin listed it at a different URL
Fixed a connector tool's approval prompt in cloud sessions being answered automatically while plugins were still loading
Changed Claude Code on the web, cloud scheduled tasks and Cowork cloud sessions to start despite `sandbox.failIfUnavailable`: the hosted container has no command sandbox

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器收緊路徑檢查與遠端查詢限制
title.en: Self-hosted runners tighten path checks and remote query limits

body.zh-TW:
透過雲端或自託管工作階段連線來查詢設定、權限規則、hooks 或狀態，現在回傳的資訊會變少或直接被拒，不過工作階段裡面實際套用的規則並沒變。

自託管執行器現在會拒絕工作階段資料夾或儲存庫路徑為符號連結的任務，只有 `checkout` 掛鉤建立的檢出路徑例外。

若自託管執行器的工作階段掛了多個儲存庫，過去執行到一半才加進來的新儲存庫會無法使用，這個問題已經修好。
body.en:
Querying settings, permission rules, hooks, or status over a cloud or self-hosted session connection now returns less information or is refused outright, though the rules actually applied inside the session remain unchanged.

Self-hosted runners now refuse tasks whose session folder or repository path is a symbolic link, except for checkout paths created by a `checkout` hook.

If a self-hosted runner session had multiple repositories attached, a new repository added mid-session was previously unusable, and this issue is now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions with several repositories being unable to use a repository added mid-session
Changed requests for settings, permission rules, hooks or status over a cloud or self-hosted session's connection to return less or be refused; what applies in the session is unchanged
Changed self-hosted runners to refuse a session whose session folder or repository path is a symbolic link, other than a `checkout` hook's checkout

title.zh-TW: 修正子代理模型誤切換並改善回答截斷處理
title.en: Fix subagent model switching and truncated reply handling

body.zh-TW:
模型設為 `opusplan` 或 `haiku` 的環境裡，原本有指定自己模型的子代理過去會被改換成計畫模式的模型，這個問題已經修好。

使用不同模型的子代理過去也會誤照主工作階段的模型去估算讀檔與 MCP 結果的大小，這項問題也已經解決。

當子代理回答到輸出 token（AI 處理的文字單位）上限被截斷時，現在不會只回傳後半段殘片，而是請它重新給出一份更簡短的完整答案。⟦請助理上台報告卻講到超時被按鈴，以前只把最後三頁講義交出來，現在請他重新把整份濃縮成一頁講完。⟧
body.en:
In environments where the model is set to `opusplan` or `haiku`, subagents with their own specified model were previously switched to the plan-mode model, and this issue is now fixed.

Subagents using a different model also previously sized file reads and MCP results using the main session's model by mistake, and that issue is resolved as well.

When a subagent's reply is cut off at the output token (a unit of text processed by AI) limit, it no longer returns just the trailing fragment, and instead is asked to provide a shorter complete answer again. ⟦Suppose an assistant runs over time during a presentation and gets buzzed off the stage: before, only the last three pages of notes were handed over, whereas now they are asked to condense the whole talk onto one page.⟧

items.original:
Fixed subagents with their own model being moved to the plan-mode model when the model setting is `opusplan` or `haiku`
Fixed subagents on a different model sizing file reads and MCP results with the main session's model
Improved subagents cut off at the output token limit: they are now asked for the whole answer again, more briefly, instead of returning only its end

title.zh-TW: 改善第三方閘道器與 Foundry 的脈絡長度處理
title.en: Improve context length handling for third-party gateways and Foundry

body.zh-TW:
當你透過企業自建或外部代理服務進行長對話時，Claude Code 過去不會自動壓縮整理內容。這會導致許多第三方閘道器與 Foundry 工作階段每回合都跳出脈絡長度錯誤而中斷，現在已經修好。

環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` 現在也能套用在名稱以 `claude-` 開頭的未知模型 ID 上。舉例來說，閘道器自訂的 `claude-sonnet-latest` 也能用這個變數設定脈絡視窗上限。⟦替新款行李箱標容量時，以前清單不認得型號就無法套用；現在即使型號不在清單上，只要符合指定的品牌開頭，也能填入容量上限。⟧
body.en:
When holding long conversations through an enterprise self-hosted or external proxy service, Claude Code previously did not compact content automatically. That caused many third-party gateway and Foundry sessions to stop with a context length error on every turn, and it is now fixed.

The environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` now also applies to unrecognized model IDs whose names start with `claude-`. For example, a gateway's custom `claude-sonnet-latest` can also use this variable to set its context window limit. ⟦Labeling capacity on a new suitcase used to fail whenever the model was missing from the catalog, but now any model starting with the specified brand prefix can still receive a capacity limit.⟧

items.original:
Fixed sessions on many third-party gateways and Foundry stopping with a context length error on every turn instead of compacting
Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` to also set the context window of unrecognized model IDs that start with `claude-`, such as a gateway's `claude-sonnet-latest`

title.zh-TW: 修正新安裝覆寫 sonnet[1m] 模型設定
title.en: Fix new installs overwriting the sonnet[1m] model setting

body.zh-TW: 當你在另一台電腦重新裝好環境並沿用舊配置時，先前儲存的偏好有時會被自動換成 API 不接受的名稱。這個把已儲存的 `sonnet[1m]` 設定改成 API 不接受名稱的問題，現在已經修好。
body.en: When setting up an environment on another computer while carrying over an old configuration, previously saved preferences could sometimes be automatically replaced with a name the API rejects. This issue of rewriting a saved `sonnet[1m]` setting to a name the API rejects is now fixed.

items.original: Fixed a saved `sonnet[1m]` model setting being rewritten on a new install to a model id the API rejects

title.zh-TW: 修正 Bedrock 計算 token 時略過組織模型限制
title.en: Fix Bedrock token counting bypassing organization model limits

body.zh-TW: 管理設定 `allowedProviders` 並不允許使用 Amazon Bedrock 的情況下，計算 token 數量的步驟過去仍會把對話內容送到 Bedrock。這個問題已經修好，現在會確實遵守該項供應商限制。
body.en: When the managed setting `allowedProviders` does not allow Amazon Bedrock, the token counting step previously still sent the conversation to Bedrock. This issue is fixed, and the provider restriction is now properly enforced.

items.original: Fixed token counting on Amazon Bedrock sending the conversation to Bedrock when the `allowedProviders` managed setting does not allow it

title.zh-TW: /cost 與預算上限現已計入模組的模型呼叫
title.en: /cost and budget limits now count mod model calls

body.zh-TW: 當你掛載了擴充套件並在工作階段裡執行自動化任務時，套件內部觸發文字生成與分類所產生的花費，現在都會算進總帳。也就是說，這些模組呼叫模型的用量會一併計入 `/cost` 指令與 `--max-budget-usd` 預算上限，並反映在費用與 token 統計指標裡。
body.en: When you load an extension and run automated tasks in a session, the cost of text generation and classification triggered inside the extension is now included in the total. That means model usage from these mods is counted toward the `/cost` command and the `--max-budget-usd` budget limit, and is reflected in cost and token metrics.

items.original: Changed `/cost`, `$.session.usage()`, `--max-budget-usd` and the cost and token metrics to count a mod's `$.model.complete` and `$.model.classify` calls

title.zh-TW: 修正 Code Mode 腳本的 worktree 與回復異常
title.en: Fix worktree and resume issues in Code Mode scripts

body.zh-TW:
在 Code Mode 執行腳本，過去會忽略透過 `EnterWorktree` 進入的 worktree，還會把 `~` 路徑誤寫進專案裡。當 MCP 伺服器登入過期後，`/mcp` 仍顯示已連線的異常也已經修好。

在權限詢問或核准計畫時，跟著 Yes 一起輸入的補充文字過去在 Code Mode 裡傳不到 Claude 手上，現在可以順利送達。

如果工作階段是在跑 Code Mode 腳本途中結束的，之後恢復該工作階段時 Claude 過去會自己先動工；現在它會乖乖停下來，等你送出下一道指示才開始。
body.en:
When running scripts in Code Mode, a worktree entered via `EnterWorktree` used to be ignored, and `~` paths were mistakenly written into the project. An issue where `/mcp` still showed an MCP server as connected after its sign-in expired is also fixed.

Extra text typed along with Yes at a permission prompt or plan approval previously failed to reach Claude in Code Mode, and now gets through.

If a session ended while running a Code Mode script, resuming that session used to make Claude start working on its own; now it stops and waits for your next instruction before starting.

items.original:
Fixed Code Mode scripts ignoring a worktree entered with `EnterWorktree`, writing `~` paths into the project, and leaving `/mcp` showing an MCP server as connected after its sign-in expired
Fixed words typed with a Yes at a permission dialog or plan approval not reaching Claude in Code Mode
Fixed Claude starting work by itself when you resumed a session that ended during a Code Mode script; it now waits for your next prompt

title.zh-TW: 修正 Agent SDK 單一無效設定清除先前設定
title.en: Fix invalid Agent SDK setting clearing earlier settings

body.zh-TW: 給串接 Agent SDK 的開發者：呼叫旗標設定介面若傳入一個無效的值，過去會默默把前面幾次呼叫存好的所有設定全部清掉。這個問題已經修好，現在遇到會造成這種後果的呼叫時會直接回傳錯誤並拒絕套用。
body.en: For developers integrating the Agent SDK: passing an invalid value to the flag settings interface used to silently wipe out all settings saved by earlier calls. This is now fixed—any call that would cause this now returns an error and refuses to apply.

items.original: Fixed one invalid value in an Agent SDK `applyFlagSettings()` call silently discarding all settings from earlier calls; a call that would do this is now refused with an error

title.zh-TW: 修正 OpenTelemetry 漏記對話提示與合併文字
title.en: Fix missing OpenTelemetry prompt events and merged text

body.zh-TW:
給設定 OpenTelemetry 遙測的管理員與開發者：工具還在執行期間送出的使用者訊息，過去會漏掉一筆對話事件紀錄。現在這筆事件會正常補上，並標示為回合中送達、綁定目前正在進行的回合。

當 VS Code 裡排隊的多則訊息合併成同一回合，或其中一則夾帶圖片時，對話事件過去會漏記前面幾則訊息的文字內容，這個問題也已經修好。
body.en:
For admins and developers configuring OpenTelemetry telemetry: user messages sent while a tool is still running used to miss a prompt event record. That event is now recorded properly, marked as delivered mid-turn and tied to the currently running turn.

Also fixed an issue where prompt events dropped the text of earlier messages when multiple queued messages in VS Code merged into a single turn, or when one of them included an image.

items.original:
Fixed a missing OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event for a message sent while tool calls run. The event has `delivery.mode: "mid_turn"` and the running turn's `prompt.id`
Fixed the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event leaving out earlier messages' text when queued messages merged into one turn in VS Code, or when one message had an image

title.zh-TW: 操作 Jupyter 筆記本後顯示重跑儲存格提示
title.en: Show cell re-run tip after Jupyter notebook edits

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 或其他整合終端機裡請 Claude 讀寫 Jupyter 筆記本時，畫面多了貼心提醒。只要 Claude 讀取或編輯過筆記本檔案，等待動畫旁的提示列現在就會提醒你可以重新執行儲存格。
body.en: When you ask Claude to read or write a Jupyter notebook in VS Code or other integrated terminals, there is now a helpful reminder on screen. Once Claude has read or edited a notebook file, the tip bar next to the spinner now reminds you that you can re-run the cell.

items.original: Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook

title.zh-TW: 遇組織封鎖或人工指令時顯示接續做法
title.en: Show next steps for org blocks and user-only commands

body.zh-TW:
組織政策擋下你的請求，錯誤訊息下方現在會多附一行接續指引，教你執行 `/rewind` 後修改原本的訊息，或直接下 `/clear` 重新開始。

如果 Claude 嘗試執行只有你本人才能跑的指令，紅色錯誤訊息底下現在也會加印一行淡色說明，提醒這個指令必須由你親自在輸入提示字元打字才會執行。
body.en:
When your organization's policy blocks a request, an extra line now appears below the error message telling you how to proceed: run `/rewind` and edit your original message, or run `/clear` to start fresh.

If Claude tries to run a command that only you can run, a dim note now appears under the red error message reminding you that the command only runs when you type it yourself at the input prompt.

items.original:
Added a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run `/rewind` and change the message, or run `/clear`
Fixed the red error shown when Claude tries a command only you can run: a dim line now says it runs only when you type it at the prompt

title.zh-TW: 連續背景回合後降低終端機提問建議更新頻率
title.en: Refresh terminal prompt suggestions less after background turns

body.zh-TW: 當你讓自動排程任務在背後默默跑了好一陣子，卻暫時沒有盯著螢幕看時，輸入框旁的下一步操作推薦就不用一直重新整理了。在連續執行滿 8 個回合後，終端機裡的提問建議會自動調降更新頻率來省下用量，直到你按下任何按鍵或切回終端機為止。⟦客廳沒人看電視時，以前遙控器選單還會一直重抓節目表，現在會減少重抓次數來省電，等你走回來或按個鍵，再恢復原本的更新頻率。⟧
body.en: When automated or scheduled tasks run quietly in the background for a while and you are not watching the screen, the next-step suggestions beside the input box no longer need to keep refreshing. After 8 turns in a row, prompt suggestions in the terminal automatically refresh less often to save usage until you press any key or switch back to the terminal. ⟦If nobody is watching TV in the living room, the remote menu used to keep reloading the program guide, whereas now it refreshes less often to save power and returns to its normal rate once you walk back or press a key.⟧

items.original: Changed prompt suggestions in the terminal to refresh less often after 8 turns in a row started by background or scheduled tasks, saving usage until you press a key or return to the terminal

title.zh-TW: 提醒 Claude 別把重要檔案存進暫存資料夾
title.en: Remind Claude to keep important files out of temp folder

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 幫忙寫出或整理之後還用得到的檔案，現在它會避開隨時可能被清空的臨時草稿暫存資料夾。Claude 的內建指令已加入這條提醒，避免你需要的成果放錯位置。
body.en: When you ask Claude to write or organize files you will still need later, it now avoids the temporary scratchpad folder that can be cleared at any time. This reminder has been added to Claude's built-in instructions so your work does not end up in the wrong place.

items.original: Changed Claude's instructions to keep files you'll want out of its temporary scratchpad folder, which can be cleared

title.zh-TW: 協作代理與新工作階段改從目前目錄啟動
title.en: Start teammates and new sessions in current directory

body.zh-TW: 你可以按 `←` 開啟代理檢視，再從裡面建立新工作階段。新開啟的環境過去常會跑到殼層最後一次 `cd` 停留的路徑。現在透過 tmux、iTerm2 啟動的協作代理，以及從代理檢視建立的新工作階段，都改從目前工作階段的資料夾啟動。
body.en: You can press `←` to open the agents view and start a new session from there. Newly opened environments used to end up in whichever path the shell last ran `cd` into. Now teammates launched via tmux or iTerm2, as well as new sessions created from the agents view, all start in the current session's folder.

items.original: Changed tmux and iTerm2 teammates, and new sessions from the agents view opened with ←, to start in the session's folder instead of where the shell last ran `cd`

title.zh-TW: 修正工作目錄被刪後指令誤在啟動目錄執行
title.en: Fix commands running in launch folder after directory deletion

body.zh-TW: 如果你正在操作的資料夾不小心被移除了，過去殼層還是會悄悄退回最初打開程式的位置繼續跑。現在指令會直接失敗並顯示訊息，之後可以重新送出指令。
body.en: If the folder you were working in was accidentally removed, the shell used to quietly fall back to the original launch location and keep running. Now the command fails right away with a message, and you can re-issue it afterward.

items.original: Fixed shell commands running in the launch directory after the working directory was deleted; the command now fails with a message and can be re-issued

title.zh-TW: 修正核准的計畫修改未能存下來
title.en: Fix approved plan edits not being saved

body.zh-TW: 如果計畫的存放資料夾寫不進去，以前你按下核准後，剛改好的內容會直接不見。現在針對這類 `plansDirectory` 寫入失敗的狀況，計畫會改存進預設的計畫資料夾，並跳出警告說明存到哪裡以及原因。
body.en: If the plans folder could not be written to, your recent edits were lost as soon as you approved the plan. Now, when writing to `plansDirectory` fails like this, the plan is saved to the default plans folder instead, and a warning explains where it was saved and why.

items.original: Fixed an approved plan edit being lost when the `plansDirectory` folder can't take it: the plan is now saved in the default plans folder, and a warning says where and why

title.zh-TW: 修正未正常結束後恢復工作階段遺失近期對話
title.en: Fix recent turns lost when resuming after an unclean exit

body.zh-TW: 如果你的終端機突然當掉或被強制關閉，事後重新接續先前的進度時，剛才最後聊的幾輪內容過去偶爾會不見。這個問題已經修好，現在恢復未正常結束的工作階段時不會再漏掉近期對話。
body.en: If your terminal suddenly crashed or was force-closed, the last few turns of your conversation could occasionally go missing when you picked up where you left off. This is now fixed, so resuming a session that did not exit cleanly no longer drops recent turns.

items.original: Fixed recent turns sometimes going missing from a resumed session after Claude Code stopped without a clean exit

title.zh-TW: 修正 PR 只需自己審核時仍顯示等待輸入
title.en: Fix PRs showing as waiting for input when only your review is needed

body.zh-TW: 當一份拉取請求的修改都已經完成、只剩你本人點頭通過或合併時，畫面過去卻還會一直停在待命的狀態。這個顯示「等待輸入」的誤判問題現在已經修好，工作階段狀態會正常顯示。
body.en: When all changes in a pull request were finished and it only needed your own approval or merge, the screen used to stay stuck in a waiting state. This false "waiting for input" status is now fixed, and the session status displays normally.

items.original: Fixed sessions showing as waiting for input when a finished pull request only needed your own review or merge

title.zh-TW: 修正簡短模式工作階段重複發送同一則回覆
title.en: Fix brief-mode sessions resending the same reply

body.zh-TW: 當你在 Dispatch 這類精簡介面裡跟 Claude 對話時，明明這一輪已經給出答案了，畫面過去有時還是會再跳出完全一樣的內容。這個在簡短模式工作階段重複發送回覆的問題已經修好，不會再重複傳送。
body.en: When chatting with Claude in a compact interface like Dispatch, the exact same reply could sometimes appear again even after the turn had already answered. This issue where brief-mode sessions sent duplicate replies is now fixed, so they will not be sent twice.

items.original: Fixed brief-mode sessions, such as Dispatch, sending a reply again after the turn had already replied

title.zh-TW: 修正終端機畫面遮擋與窄視窗換行問題
title.en: Fix terminal display overlap and narrow-window wrapping

body.zh-TW:
焦點檢視下，如果排程任務在 Claude 已經回覆你的提問後才回覆，原本給你的那則回覆過去會被藏起來。關閉全螢幕，背景子代理檢視裡偶爾也會漏掉提問內容，這兩項顯示問題都已經修好。

清單與權限詢問視窗裡的長選項折行時過去會彼此蓋掉一部分，窄終端機上的首次啟動畫面也會漏掉幾行，現在排版都已經修正。

啟動時關於權限規則的警告與「N MCP servers need authentication」通知，過去就算被捲出畫面外仍會被標成已讀。這個錯誤標記為已看過的問題已經修好。

當代理名稱或工作資料夾裡含有控制字元或換行符號時，歡迎頁眉過去會印出亂碼控制字元或斷成多行，這個問題也已經修好。
body.en:
In focus view, if a scheduled task replied after Claude had already answered your prompt, the original reply to you used to get hidden. With fullscreen off, the prompt could also occasionally go missing in a background subagent view, and both display issues are now fixed.

Long options in lists and permission prompts used to partly overwrite each other when wrapping, and first-run screens on narrow terminals would lose a few lines; both layout issues are now fixed.

Startup warnings about permission rules and the "N MCP servers need authentication" notice used to be marked as read even when scrolled out of view. This issue where they were mistakenly marked as seen is now fixed.

When an agent's name or the working folder contained control characters or line breaks, the welcome header used to print garbled control characters or split across multiple lines; this is now fixed as well.

items.original:
Fixed focus view hiding the reply to your prompt when a scheduled task replied after it
Fixed the prompt sometimes missing from a background subagent's view when fullscreen is off
Fixed long options in lists and permission prompts being partly overwritten when they wrap, and first-run screens losing lines on narrow terminals
Fixed startup warnings about permission rules and the "N MCP servers need authentication" notice being recorded as seen when they were scrolled out of view
Fixed the welcome header showing control characters or splitting across lines when an agent's name or the working folder contains them or a line break

title.zh-TW: 修正 claude -p 在終端機輸出多餘控制序列
title.en: Fix claude -p printing extra control sequences to terminals

body.zh-TW: 當你用單次指令模式直接把純文字結果印在畫面上時，過去裡面會夾帶許多排版顏色以外的亂碼指令。這個 `claude -p` 在終端機輸出多餘控制序列的問題已經修好，現在只保留樣式控制，導向管線或檔案的輸出則維持不變。
body.en: When using single-command mode to print plain-text output directly on screen, the output used to include extra garbled sequences beyond text styling. This issue where `claude -p` printed extra control sequences to a terminal is now fixed so only styling controls remain, while output sent to pipes or files stays unchanged.

items.original: Fixed `claude -p` text output on a terminal passing control sequences other than text styling; pipes and files are unchanged

title.zh-TW: 改善 /voice 的設定鎖定與麥克風選擇提示
title.en: Improve /voice settings-lock and microphone selection prompts

body.zh-TW:
當管理員設定、`--settings` 參數，或專案裡的設定檔把語音模式鎖住時，過去打 `/voice` 仍會誤報模式已切換。這些設定檔包含 `.claude/settings.json` 與 `.claude/settings.local.json`。現在被鎖住時，`/voice` 會直接告訴你是哪一份設定把它固定住。

在 macOS 與 Windows 上如果看到 `/voice` 跳出「No audio detected」訊息，畫面現在也會直接指點你該去哪裡挑選麥克風。⟦對講機被公司鎖了頻道或沒插好耳麥時，以前只會一直喊切換成功或沒聲音，現在會直接告訴你是誰鎖住、該去哪裡挑麥克風。⟧
body.en:
When managed settings, the `--settings` flag, or project configuration files kept voice mode locked, running `/voice` used to falsely report that the mode had switched. These configuration files include `.claude/settings.json` and `.claude/settings.local.json`. Now, when voice mode is locked, `/voice` tells you directly which setting is holding it in place.

If you see the "No audio detected" message from `/voice` on macOS or Windows, the screen now points you directly to where you can pick your microphone. ⟦A walkie-talkie with a company-locked channel or an unplugged headset used to just keep claiming it switched or had no sound, whereas now it tells you who locked it and where to pick your microphone.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/voice` saying voice mode changed when managed settings, `--settings`, or the project's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` kept it as it was; it now says what holds it
Improved the `/voice` "No audio detected" message on macOS and Windows: it now says where to pick your microphone

title.zh-TW: 修正 /stats 天數多算與 /insights 報表錯誤
title.en: Fix /stats day overcounting and /insights report bugs

body.zh-TW:
執行 `/stats` 查看統計，裡面的活躍天數過去會多算一天，這個問題已經修好。

當沒有任何工作階段符合分析條件時，`/insights` 過去仍會通知報告已備妥，而且寫進 HTML 報告的兩個數值沒有先經過跳脫處理，這兩個錯誤也已經修好。
body.en:
When running `/stats` to view statistics, the active days total used to be counted one day too high; this is now fixed.

When no sessions qualified for analysis, `/insights` used to still announce that a report was ready, and two values written into its HTML report were not escaped first; both bugs are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `/stats` showing an Active days total that was one day too high
Fixed `/insights` saying a report was ready when no session qualified for analysis, and writing two values into its HTML report without escaping them

title.zh-TW: 修正 claude purge 在無終端機與管線輸入卡住
title.en: Fix claude purge hanging without a terminal or with piped input

body.zh-TW: 在沒有終端機可讀取按鍵的環境下跑 `claude purge`，過去會靜靜卡死。當透過管線把內容送進標準輸入時，專案挑選器與 `-i` 提示也會不理會鍵盤操作，這兩個互動問題都已經修好。
body.en: Running `claude purge` in an environment without a terminal to read keystrokes from used to hang silently. When content was piped into standard input, the project picker and `-i` prompts would also ignore keyboard input; both interactive issues are now fixed.

items.original: Fixed `claude purge` hanging silently when there is no terminal to read keys from, and its project picker and `-i` prompts ignoring the keyboard when stdin is piped

title.zh-TW: 修正無效 teammateMode 設定值未跳出警告
title.en: Fix missing warning for invalid teammateMode settings

body.zh-TW: 設定檔裡的 `teammateMode` 若填了無法辨識的值，過去會直接略過且不提醒。現在 `claude -p`、啟動警告與 `claude doctor` 都會把它列為已跳過的項目，不過一樣不會套用這個無效值。
body.en: If `teammateMode` in a settings file had an unrecognized value, it used to be silently ignored without any warning. Now `claude -p`, the startup warning, and `claude doctor` all list it as a skipped entry, while still not applying the invalid value.

items.original: Fixed an unrecognized `teammateMode` settings value being ignored without a warning: `claude -p`, the startup warning and `claude doctor` now list it as a skipped entry (still not applied)

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 與 Linux 的 IDE 歡迎視窗快捷鍵
title.en: Fixed IDE welcome dialog shortcut on Windows and Linux

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 與 Linux 上打開 IDE 歡迎對話框，Quick Launch 快速啟動的快捷鍵提示過去會誤顯示成 Cmd+Esc。這個顯示錯誤已經修好。
body.en: Opening the IDE welcome dialog on Windows and Linux used to show Cmd+Esc as the shortcut hint for Quick Launch by mistake. That display bug is now fixed.

items.original: Fixed the IDE welcome dialog showing Cmd+Esc for Quick Launch on Windows and Linux

title.zh-TW: 修正組織禁止雲端工作階段時仍顯示 Slack 提示
title.en: Fixed Slack tips appearing when your organization denies cloud sessions

body.zh-TW: 明明公司不開放雲端環境，畫面上過去還是會冒出 Slack 應用程式的小提示。這個問題已經修好，只要組織政策禁止雲端工作階段，這類提示就不會再出現。
body.en: Even when your company did not allow cloud environments, Slack app tips used to pop up on screen. That issue is fixed, and those tips no longer appear when organization policy denies cloud sessions.

items.original: Fixed Slack app tips showing when your organization's policy denies cloud sessions

title.zh-TW: 修正桌面版第三方部署停在「Stopping」狀態
title.en: Fixed desktop third-party deployments hanging on "Stopping"

body.zh-TW: 當你在企業自建的環境裡開啟 Claude Desktop 並準備結束對話時，畫面過去會在權杖更新完成前一直卡住不動。只要該第三方部署環境納入了這個版本，停在「Stopping」狀態的問題就會解決。
body.en: When you opened Claude Desktop in a self-hosted enterprise environment and tried to end a conversation, the screen used to stay stuck until a token renewal finished. Once that third-party deployment includes this version, the issue of hanging on "Stopping" is resolved.

items.original: Fixed Claude Desktop's third-party deployments staying on "Stopping" until a token renewal finished (once it includes this version)

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 因 PATH 目錄無權限而啟動卡頓
title.en: Fixed Windows startup stall from inaccessible PATH folders

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上，只要環境變數 PATH 裡有某個項目位於你帳號打不開的資料夾底下，Claude Code 啟動時過去可能會停頓約一秒。這個問題已經修好，現在不會再因此卡住。
body.en: On Windows, whenever an entry in the PATH environment variable sat under a folder your account could not open, Claude Code could stall for about a second at startup. This issue is fixed, so it will no longer hang for that reason.

items.original: Windows: Fixed a start-up stall that could last about a second when a PATH entry sits under a folder your account cannot open

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 版 /resume 路徑大小寫與信任異常
title.en: Fixed Windows /resume path case and trust issues

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 上使用 `/resume` 恢復舊工作階段，如果當時紀錄的資料夾路徑磁碟代號大小寫或斜線方向不同，工作階段過去會被拒絕或隱藏。這個問題已經修好，現在都能正常找到並恢復。

同樣在 Windows 的工作階段內執行 `/resume` 時，若路徑磁碟代號大小寫不同，過去還會順帶丟掉已儲存的專案信任狀態，現在也不會再發生。
body.en:
Using `/resume` on Windows to restore an old session used to fail with a refusal or hide the session if its recorded folder path had a different drive-letter case or slash direction. That is now fixed, so those sessions can be found and restored normally.

Similarly, running `/resume` inside a Windows session when the path's drive-letter case differed used to also drop the project's saved trust state, which will no longer happen.

items.original:
Fixed `/resume` on Windows refusing or hiding sessions whose folder was recorded with a different drive-letter case or slashes
Fixed an in-session `/resume` on Windows dropping a project's saved trust when the session was recorded with a different drive-letter case

title.zh-TW: VS Code 版輸入框也會提示下一句提問建議
title.en: VS Code input box now suggests your next prompt

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 請 Claude 改完一段程式，還在想下一步該補測試還是看差異嗎？輸入框現在會在終端機同樣會出現的時機，直接浮出建議的下一句提問，按 `Tab` 就能馬上採用。⟦去吃旋轉壽司時，以前得自己一直盯著轉盤想下一盤要吃什麼，現在師傅會依你剛點的菜色先把合拍的下一道推到面前，想吃就順手夾走。⟧

如果覺得提示有點干擾，在 Claude Code 的 `settings.json` 加上這行就能關掉：

```json
{"promptSuggestionEnabled": false}
```
body.en:
After asking Claude to edit code in VS Code, wondering whether to add tests or check the diff next? The input box now surfaces a suggested next prompt at the same moments the terminal does, and pressing `Tab` accepts it right away. ⟦At a conveyor-belt sushi bar, you used to stare at the belt wondering what plate to pick next, whereas now the chef slides a matching next dish right in front of you based on what you just ordered so you can grab it.⟧

If you find the suggestions distracting, add this line to Claude Code's `settings.json` to turn them off:

```json
{"promptSuggestionEnabled": false}
```

items.original: [VSCode] Added prompt suggestions wherever the terminal shows them: Tab accepts the suggested next prompt; `promptSuggestionEnabled: false` in Claude Code's settings.json turns them off

title.zh-TW: 改善 VS Code 版的登入驗證流程與錯誤引導
title.en: Improved VS Code sign-in flow and error guidance

body.zh-TW:
VS Code 擴充套件現在新增了不會建立 API 金鑰的 Console 主控台登入方式，不用為了登入額外生出一把金鑰。

在 SSH、WSL 或容器視窗從面板登入 MCP 伺服器時，畫面上現在多了欄位讓你直接貼上重新導向網址。

管理設定 `allowedProviders` 已經禁止的登入選項，過去還是會列在登入畫面上，這個問題已經修好。

瀏覽器如果對 `localhost` 回報連線錯誤，登入卡片現在會直接告訴你該怎麼處理解決。
body.en:
The VS Code extension now includes a Console sign-in method that creates no API key, so you do not have to generate an extra key just to log in.

When signing in to an MCP server from the panel in SSH, WSL, or container windows, the screen now includes a field where you can paste the redirect URL directly.

Sign-in options already blocked by the managed `allowedProviders` setting used to still appear on the sign-in screen, which is now fixed.

If your browser reports a connection error for `localhost`, the sign-in card now tells you directly how to resolve it.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Console sign-in that creates no API key
[VSCode] Added a field to paste the redirect URL when signing in to an MCP server from the panel in SSH, WSL and container windows
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen offering sign-ins that the managed `allowedProviders` setting refuses
[VSCode] Improved the sign-in card to say what to do when the browser shows a connection error for localhost

title.zh-TW: 修正 VS Code 版模型勾選與思考力度越界
title.en: Fixed VS Code model check mark and effort cap

body.zh-TW:
Claude Code 改用另一個模型重啟，或透過 Remote Control 切換模型後，VS Code 裡的模型選單過去還會把勾選記號留在舊模型上。這個顯示錯誤已經修好。

思考力度選單過去也會列出超過組織上限或 `maxEffortLevel` 設定的選項，現在已不再顯示超過上限的等級。
body.en:
After Claude Code restarted on another model or switched models over Remote Control, the model picker in VS Code used to leave its check mark on the old model. That display bug is now fixed.

The effort selector also used to list options above the cap set by your organization or the `maxEffortLevel` setting, and it now stops showing levels above that limit.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the model picker's check mark staying on the old model after Claude Code restarted on another model or the model was switched over Remote Control
[VSCode] Fixed the effort selector offering levels above the effort cap set by your organization or the `maxEffortLevel` setting

title.zh-TW: 改善 VS Code 版的安全詢問與封鎖提示文字
title.en: Improved VS Code safety prompts and block messages

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 裡因安全檢查跳出 MCP 工具的權限詢問，對話框現在會說明 Claude Code 為什麼需要問你。

組織設定載入失敗時的訊息不再叫你重跑指令，而是改成與分頁上「Retry」連結一致的「再試一次」提示。

打開不受信任的資料夾時，通知現在會清楚交代為什麼擴充套件被停用，以及該怎麼重新開啟。

如果作業系統阻擋執行 Claude Code，錯誤訊息現在會告訴你，IT 團隊可以允許執行被封鎖的程式。

透過安裝連結開啟外掛市集時，確認按鈕的文字現在改為「Trust marketplace and continue」。
body.en:
When a safety check triggers a permission prompt for MCP tools in VS Code, the dialog now explains why Claude Code needs to ask you.

The message when organization settings fail to load no longer tells you to run a command again, and instead asks you to "try again" to match the tab's "Retry" link.

When you open an untrusted folder, the notification now clearly explains why the extension is disabled and how to turn it back on.

If your operating system blocks Claude Code from running, the error message now lets you know that your IT team can allow the blocked program.

When opening the plugin marketplace through an install link, the confirmation button text now reads "Trust marketplace and continue".

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt for MCP tools not saying why Claude Code asks when a safety check raises the question
[VSCode] Fixed the message for organization settings that couldn't load saying to run a command again; it now says to try again, matching the tab's Retry link
[VSCode] Improved the note shown for an untrusted folder: it now says why the extension is off and how to turn it on
[VSCode] Improved the error shown when the system refuses to run Claude Code: it now says your IT team can allow a blocked program
[VSCode] Changed the install link's marketplace confirmation button to "Trust marketplace and continue"

title.zh-TW: 修正網頁版載入 MCP 工具說明在四千字截斷
title.en: Fixed web MCP tool descriptions cutting off at 4,096 chars

body.zh-TW: 在新的雲端工作階段透過工具搜尋載入 MCP 工具說明，過去只要超過 4,096 個字元就會被砍掉後半段。這個針對網頁版 MCP 工具說明的限制問題已經修好，現在上限已提高到 16,384 個字元，與其他環境的 Claude Code 一致。
body.en: When loading MCP tool descriptions through tool search in new cloud sessions, anything past 4,096 characters used to get cut off. This limit issue for MCP tool descriptions on the web is now fixed, raising the cap to 16,384 characters to match Claude Code in other environments.

items.original: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed new cloud sessions cutting MCP tool descriptions loaded through tool search at 4,096 characters; the limit is now 16,384, as in other Claude Code sessions

title.zh-TW: 修正登入過期時 Slack Artifact 連結無卡片
title.en: Fix missing card for Slack Artifact links when sign-in expires

body.zh-TW: 同事在組織未管理的 Slack 工作區貼上 Artifact 連結，而張貼者的 Claude 登入已經過期。聊天室裡過去會完全生不出預覽區塊。這個在非組織管理 Slack 工作區貼上 Artifact 連結的問題已經修好，現在會顯示一張簡單的卡片。
body.en: A colleague pastes an Artifact link in a Slack workspace not managed by their organization while the poster's Claude sign-in has expired. Previously, no preview block would appear in the chat at all. This issue with pasting Artifact links in a Slack workspace not managed by the organization is fixed, and a plain card now appears.

items.original: [Claude Tag] Fixed artifact links pasted in Slack getting no card when the poster's Claude sign-in had expired in a workspace their organization doesn't manage; a plain card now appears
